articleTitle: An unsupervised hybrid model based on CNN and ViT for multimodal medical image fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The multimodal medical image fusion (MMIF) technology aims to integrate complementary information from multiple different modal images into an image. The existing fusion methods cannot capture the global context information effectively, thus the fusion performance is limited. In this paper, an unsupervised hybrid model based on CNN and vision transformer (ViT) for multimodal medical image fusion is proposed. Our model combines the advantages of the CNN and ViT model, it can not only capture the global context information and bring stronger learning ability, but also introduce the inductive bias of CNN to improve the generalization performance. Furthermore, a novel complementarity information fidelity loss is proposed, it performs a constraint for enhanced preservation of complementarity information in fused results, hence, the better fusion effect can be obtained. Both qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method over the state-of-the-art fusion methods.

articleTitle: Multi-user Computation Offloading Algorithm for Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Mobile Edge computing (MEC), a new computing model to deal with the growing data, can better meet the needs of users. However, the simple edge computation offloading strategy is no longer suitable for the current MEC architecture. To solve the computation offloading problem of computation-intensive and time-sensitive tasks in Mobile Edge Computing (MEC), a joint partial offloading and task priority computation offloading algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the algorithm comprehensively considers the computing capability of the mobile device, the time delay and energy consumption of computing the task to determine whether the task needs to be offloaded. Then, the priority is determined for the tasks that need to be offloaded and the MEC servers. Finally, according to the determined priority, the tasks with high priority are offloaded to the MEC servers with strong computing capability to complete resource allocation. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional computation offloading algorithms, the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the time delay and energy consumption cost of the MEC system.

articleTitle: Chinese Text Classification Based on ERNIE-RNN
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Text classification is a popular task of natural language processing. At present, text classification has been applied to multiple language like English, Chinese, Arabic et.al. However, Chinese text classification has many challenges especially in feature extraction and feature selection. This paper proposes the structure of ERNIE-RNN model. We use ERNIE to learn the complete semantic representation of a semantic unit instead of the traditional model to generate the word vector. RNN model is attached to the ERNIE model which can better process sequence information especially when preceding input is related to the following input for some certain task like text classification. In this paper, we use the data from our project which is tax consulting questions correspond to tax application scenarios. Our experimental results showed solid performance of all models on our data with a top performance of 94.63%, achieved by our model ERNIE-RNN.

articleTitle: A Model and Method of Information System Security Risk Assessment based on MITRE ATT&CK
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of information system risk early warning, an information system risk assessment method (Advantageous Tactics, Technologies, and Common Knowledge - Optimized Analytic Hierarchy Process - Bayesian Network, ATT&CK-OAHP-BN) based on MITRE ATT&CK model is proposed. Firstly, a hierarchical risk assessment indicators system is constructed based on the ATT&CK knowledge graph. Then, the weight of each indicator is calculated by OAHP algorithm, and the initial probability of each risk indicator is determined. Finally, according to the Bayesian network reasoning model, the posterior probability that each risk indicator may lead to security threat is calculated. The example analysis results show that this method can calculate the risk value of security threat caused by various attack tactics and techniques, so as to effectively determine the risk indicator that should be paid attention to when the information system is under security threat.

articleTitle: The Use of Cloud Firestore For Handling Real-time Data Updates: An Empirical Study of Gamified Online Quiz
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The need for technological solutions that can help improve interactivity in online learning environments is increasing during the COVID-19 pandemic. One technological solution that has been proven is the use of gamified online quizzes such as Kahoot!. One of the issues when using existing third-party platforms is related to integration with existing learning platforms. Institutions that have sufficient resources can solve this by developing solutions that are easily integrated with existing learning platforms. This paper discusses how to use database technology that can handle real-time data updates to develop a gamified online quiz system. In this experimental study, UML use cases and sequence diagrams were used to describe the functional requirements and behavior of the system. Further, entity-relationship model was also used to help the database implementation process. Two database technologies, namely Cloud Firestore and CouchDB, were compared to see how they perform in handling real-time data updates and how much they cost. The comparison results show that Cloud Firestore is better in terms of latency and more cost-effective than CouchDB.

articleTitle: Multiple UAVs Forest Fire Fighting using a hierarchical task planning method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: A task planning approach is proposed for multiunmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in a forest fire fighting mission considering obstacles and simultaneous arrival. The approach consists of three stages, in the first stage, the estimate arrival time between UAVs and targets are calculated by the rapidly-exploring random tree (RRT) algorithm, which serves as input to solve task assignment problem. Then, a distributed task assignment method using auction mechanism is employed to allocate these fire spots aiming to minimize the fire-fighting mission time, the value and resources requirement of fire spots are considered. In the last stages, a modified cooperative particle swarm optimization algorithm is designed for these UAVs to reach the fire spot simultaneously, kinematic constraint of UAV and collision avoidance with mountains are considered. Simulation examples are used to validate the proposed methods.

articleTitle: An Effective Encrypted Traffic Classification Method Based on Pruning Convolutional Neural Networks for Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing technology, the traffic of cloud platform also increases rapidly. Most of these traffic adopt encryption technology, the original traffic classification method is no longer effective. In this paper, we propose an efficient encrypted traffic classification method based on pruning convolution neural network: PCNN. This method does not need to extract features manually, but automatically extracts high-level features through CNN, which makes the model have generalization ability and reduces the cost. Then the pruning technology is adopted to prune the model and retain the parameters that are highly important to the model, which greatly reduces the size and computation of the model and will not affect the performance of the model. We used the public network dataset ISCXVPN2016 to verify our proposed method, the experiments show that the F1 score of our proposed approach is 93% which is improved by 3%, and the precision is 94%, which is improved by 5%.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Situation Prediction Based on Improved and Optimized BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: For the sake of better mastering the dynamic changes of network security, in view of its nonlinear time series characteristics, this paper proposes a combination of genetic algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm to improve and optimize the BP neural network. After trial and error, the model was constructed and applied to actual predictions. The results reflect BP neural network on the basis of genetic simulated annealing(GSA-BP) algorithm is effective in predicting the situation of network security.

articleTitle: Adaptive Filter-Based Approach for PHY Fingerprints Extraction of Fast Ethernet Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Access control is a common part of network security measure. However, the existing access control mechanism is mostly limited to distinguish users based on digital authentication methods such as MAC addresses, which are vulnerable to forgery and counterfeiting attacks. Using distinguishable physical-layer (PHY) based on fingerprints from devices and MAC-based ID verification is a popular method for enhancing network security. Extracting device finger-prints is the crucial step in this enhanced security method. In this paper, different from the existing fingerprint extraction method based on the preamble, we propose an adaptive filter-based method of fingerprint extraction. The method utilizes more signal regions to extract finer fingerprints, which is not limited to the preamble. Our results show that with a filter order of 65 and 20 times averaging, among 13 devices can be classified with 98% accuracy under the Multiple Discriminant Analysis, Maximum Likelihood (MDA/ML) classifier.

articleTitle: A Modified AODV Routing Protocol Using In WSN Based On Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: AODV is a lightweight routing protocol for ad hoc networks, but there are some faults such as not considering the energy consumption of nodes and frequent flooding when it is used in WSN. In order to make up for its shortcomings, an modified AODV protocol is designed by introducing the idea of ant colony algorithm. It provides multiple optional routes, reduces the flooding probability, and can protect low-power nodes, which is more suitable for WSN networks. Simulation results show that the modified AODV protocol reduces the energy consumption of nodes, prolongs the life of nodes, and effectively improves the stability and communication efficiency of the network.

articleTitle: Clock Domain Crossing Verification Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Clock Domain crossing is one of the critical aspects of chip design. As the technology node shrink, more IPs can be squeezed into single chip, the chip architecture complexity also increases with more features included. Hence, clock domains crossing probability also increase as more clocks domains co-exists within single chip. The need of clock domain crossing verification also increases and no longer enough to be simple design review and verification. The intend of this paper is to provide an overview of clock domain crossing verification challenges and watchouts. Hopefully it will benefit the community.

articleTitle: A Survey of EEG Analysis based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: EEG signals reflect the activity of the brain. Previous studies based on EEG signal recognition focused on extracting temporal features of EEG and have not yet considered the topology of EEG signal channels, missing important spatial information. Graph neural networks view EEG signals as vertices of a graph and capture the implicit topological relationships between signals. In this review, we review the basic models of graph networks and their variants, including graph convolutional neural networks, graph attention networks, etc., summarize the applications in the fields of emotion recognition, epilepsy diagnosis, and finally present an outlook based on current challenges.

articleTitle: Research on Bus Passenger Flow Statistics Based on Video Images
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to meet the travel needs of inhabitant, buses as a travel mode of “low-carbon, environmental protection and green travel” have been widely used, so the statistics of public transport passenger flow has gradually become an important reference data source for rational traffic planning and optimization of public vehicle route scheduling. Aiming at the impact of incorrect counting caused by complex conditions such as movement, crowding and occlusion in the actual bus surveillance video scene, this paper adopts the passenger flow statistics system with the passenger's head area as the target detection. The algorithm proposed in this paper mainly uses the head area of the passengers getting on and off as the target feature to be extracted, and on this basis, the image processing and recognition operations are performed. Then input the above results into the target tracking algorithm to be used to estimate and preprocess it, and then use the data information obtained by the algorithm to achieve the association matching between multiple targets. Finally, the counting is completed by analyzing the target motion trajectory, so as to realize the statistics of boarding and alighting passenger flow. The experimental results show that the passenger flow statistics have strong robustness, track and count the target passengers accurately, and meet the needs of actual passenger flow statistics.

articleTitle: QoE Assessment of Angle Perception with Haptics for Networked Virtual Environments
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper examines human perception of angle for networked haptic virtual environments by Quality of Experience (QoE) assessment. In the assessment, subjects make a comparison between each of eleven angles (called the standard angles here) and tested angles by using our angle perception system. The subjects answer whether each tested angle is different from its standard angle, and we obtain the ratio of the number of subjects who notice the difference to the total number of subjects. Assessment results demonstrate that the ratio is largely dependent on the standard angle and the angle difference.

articleTitle: Adaptive clustering feature matching algorithm based on SIFT and RANSAC
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) algorithm is widely used in the field of image matching. The traditional SIFT does not perform well in terms of computational complexity and matching accuracy in complex scenes. Based on the above problems, an improved SIFT and RANSAC algorithm is proposed in this paper. When selecting extreme points, the original 26 reference points in DOG space are extended to 32 reference points within Manhattan distance 2. By establishing 8 concentric circle neighborhoods with increasing radius in the sampling sub area, the latitude of keypoint descriptor is reduced to 64 dimensions. When performing matching, it first goes through KNN coarse matching, and then uses the score function to calculate the scores of the two clustering result sets, keypoint descriptor Euclidean distance clustering and spatial location clustering, and uses the high score set as input to improve the input parameters and the number of iterations of RANSAC. The simulation results show that the algorithm in this paper can further improve the correct matching rate with good robustness in a variety of scenes compared with the traditional algorithm and some other related algorithms.

articleTitle: QINR: A Quantum-Inspired Network for Interpretable Review-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Recent studies in recommender systems have managed to achieve significantly improved performance by leveraging reviews for rating prediction. However, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been widely adopted in recent methods, which are difficult to intuitively understand and interpret. To make the recommendation process more transparent and interpretable, we seek to model reviews by the mathematical framework of quantum physics rather than general deep learning methods. In this paper, we propose a Quantum-Inspired Network for interpretable review-based Recommendation (QINR), which models reviews with the well-designed mathematical formulations in quantum physics and further predicts user ratings for items. Specifically, reviews are represented by density matrices and a set of measurement operators are applied to the density matrices. Experiments on the Amazon datasets demonstrate that QINR outperforms recent recommendation methods in terms of mean square errors (MSE).

articleTitle: Research on Classification of Kazakh Questions Integrate with Multi-feature Embedding
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Kazakh is an agglutinative language, and this feature results in data sparseness to some extent. In addition, the Kazakh question sentences lack strict grammatical rules, and the word forms are changeable and irregular. Due to this, this article proposes a CNN+BiGRU question classification model and attention mechanism that integrate multi-features based on the Kazakh language characteristics. Kazakh words and language features are used as input for the neural network. The CNN network generates high-dimensional semantic features and transmits the output to the BiGRU network. The BiGRU layer models the context information, then the Attention layer concentrates on the input features, filters out the unnecessary information, and completes the classification with SoftMax. The research in this paper shows that our model effectively integrates language features, avoids data sparsity, improves the model's performance during training, and has higher performance on the classification of Kazakh questions.

articleTitle: Homomorphic Proxy Re-Signcryption Scheme and Its Application in Edge Computing-Enhanced IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Proxy re-signcryption combines the functionalities of re-encryption and re-signature in a single logical step, outperforming a simple combination of re-encryption and re-signature schemes. Proxy re-signcryption ensures the confidentiality of data transmission as well as the anonymity of the sender's identity in the public network, so it can be applied in smart grid, machine learning and other fields. However, only a few proxy re-signcryption schemes exist, and none of them support the homomorphic operations of ciphertext data. In this paper, we offer a homomorphic proxy re-signcryption scheme that leverages batch verification and achieves the conversion between ciphertext and signature. Based on the proposed proxy re-signcryption scheme, we also give a privacy-preserving data aggregation scheme for edge computing-enhanced IoT, which allows the control center to perform statistical analysis and processing on the data collected by IoT devices.

articleTitle: A Modified Particle Swarm Optimization for the Applications of Electromagnetic Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is a global search algorithm based on swarm intelligence. The PSO is becoming more popular because of solving complex and complicated benchmark optimization problems. The mathematical model of PSO is easy due to few control parameters. However, the PSO algorithm are stuck due to premature convergence while dealing with high dimensional problems. To handle this issue the current research paper introducing especial best particle that incorporated in the updating equations. Also, the novel best particle control the diversity of the search process and keep a decent balance between the exploration and exploitation searches. The experimental outcomes demonstrates that the novel algorithm performs well as compared to other one.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling Problem of Mine Water Based on Swarm Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of cumbersome scheduling operation, low recycling efficiency, and insufficient data collection and analysis of coal mine water reuse system, this paper proposes a mine water information processing framework based on edge computing and uses particle swarm optimization algorithm to process and optimize mine water data. In order to reduce the time of mine water information processing and improve the efficiency of mine water dispatching, this paper uses a particle swarm optimization algorithm to calculate a reasonable mine water dispatching scheme. In this paper, the water quality and water quantity data of Nalinhe No.2 mine are taken as the research object to analyze the reuse rate and reuse time under different scheduling schemes. The simulation results show that the optimal scheduling under the edge computing framework can increase the mine water reuse rate by 17.5% and reduce the reuse time by 117.51h/month, effectively improving the operating efficiency of the mine treatment system.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of Car-Following Model Considering Multiple-Velocity Difference and Changes with Memory
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to enhance the stability of car-following traffic flow in the traffic system, based on the full velocity difference (FVD) model, a Multiple-Velocity Difference and Changes with Memory (MVDCM) model is deduced with comprehensive consideration of the velocity difference and memory effect of multiple preceding vehicles. In the model, we introduce the velocity difference information and changes with memory effect of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> vehicles in front, in order to solve the delay problem in the FVD model caused by the indirect analysis of the velocity information of the front and rear vehicles. By using linear stability analysis and figure out the critical conditions for judging the stability of the traffic flow, then use Matlab to do numerical simulations and analyses. Simulation results show that under the same initial disturbance conditions, the MVDCM model has a lower velocity fluctuation and a larger stable area than the optimal velocity (OV) model, the FVD model and the Multiple-Velocity difference (MVD) model, especially when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k=3,\ \lambda=0.2$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\gamma=0.1$</tex>, the average volatility is as low as 0.26%. Consequently, the proposed model can effectively improve the stability of the car-following traffic system and alleviate traffic jams.

articleTitle: Opinion Analysis and Emotion Prediction Based on Review Mining of New Energy Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Social media public opinion contains a hot topic in the new energy automobile industry. Python is used to crawl the microblog, Today's headlines and other platform texts, and LDA model is constructed to classify the three themes of automobile parameters, listed brands and market information. Then, the consumer review data of automobile homes are crawled to dig out the preferences of consumers as appearance, endurance and motivation, and the pain points of consumers as charging, space and back row. Finally, a random forest model is constructed for sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Efficient Dynamic Spectrum Sharing for LTE-NR Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: To cater to the 5G requirements for the data rate and capacity, dynamic spectrum sharing (DSS) is proposed to improve spectrum efficiency. However, sharing the spectrum between the 4G and 5G users dynamically will result in significant interference. Especially, the inter-cell interference caused by cell reference signals from LTE cells reduces the 5G system performance severely. To reduce the interference, mechanisms such as RE-level rate matching, RB-level rate matching, and control channel avoidance are proposed. However, these methods introduce additional spectrum overhead. To further improve the 5G system performance, some enhanced mechanisms such as multiple cell-specific reference signals (CRS) patterns, Type B enhancements, and cross-carrier scheduling are introduced. Specifically, the paper introduces the mechanisms of DSS, and analyses the cost of these mechanisms. In addition, the paper illustrates the test results of 2.1G 40M partial DSS and compares the performance of 40M partial DSS in different scenarios. Finally, we give some suggestions for the DSS deployment.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Vehicle Sales Forecast and Product Optimization Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Driven by the “dual carbon” goal, the development of new energy vehicles is the trend. Facing the complex and changeable market situation, only by understanding the trend and grasping the user demand, can we grasp the development opportunity. This paper uses data mining and empirical analysis to study the new energy vehicle companies in which subdivisions are more promising, how to optimize products and reasonable pricing to obtain higher profits. The SARIMA model and exponential smoothing method are used to fit the sales data of new energy vehicles from 2011 to 2019 through python, and the SARIMA model with better fitting effect is used to predict the sales in 2025. The LASSO regression is used to determine the parameters that have a greater impact on the sales of new energy vehicles, and then the K-means clustering analysis and multiple linear regression are used for correlation analysis. The prediction formula of sales and eight product parameters is fitted to provide support for enterprise production.

articleTitle: Application of Cryptography Based on Elliptic Curves
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: ECC (Elliptic Curve Cryptography) is based on the algebraic structure of elliptic curves over finite fields that allows the use of smaller encryption keys compared to other cryptographies (e.g., using Galois fields) while maintaining an equivalent level of security [1]. Elliptic curves are used for key exchange, digital signatures, pseudo-random generators, and other tasks. They can also be used for encryption in combination with symmetric encryption. The content of this article is the protection of data transmission in a wireless network using elliptic curves.

articleTitle: A Fast Sea-sky Line Detection Method Based on EDLines
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As the dividing line between the sky area and the water surface area, sea-sky line (SSL) can not only be used to extract the area where the target may exist, but also can be used to stabilize the image collected on the sailing unmanned surface vehicle (USV). The image obtained by the ship-borne camera contains a lot of interference due to factors such as waves and reflections. Existing methods cannot guarantee the accuracy, robustness, and real-time requirements of SSL detection at the same time. In our method, the pixels where the gradient is a local peak in the vertical direction are chosen as the key points of detection and a novel and effective pixel connection rule is proposed. The proposed method is tested on visual images collected by USV. While ensuring accuracy and robustness, the average processing time of a single frame of image is less than that of the existing methods and meets real-time requirement.

articleTitle: A Novel 24 / 15 pole Bearingless Switched Reluctance Motor and Sensorless Speed Control
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In view of the problems of small levitation force and negative torque in the traditional bearingless switched reluctance motor, a new 24/15 pole bearingless switched reluctance motor with hybrid rotor tooth structure is proposed. The rotor teeth are divided into torque teeth, levitation teeth and support teeth to increase the pole arc of support teeth and reduce the influence of levitation force on torque. The performance of the motor is simulated and verified by Maxwell 2D. The results show that the suspension performance of the structure is better and the torque output is improved. At the same time, in order to reduce the volume and cost of the motor, the sliding mode observer is used for sensorless control of the motor. The motor model and sliding mode observer model are built and simulated in Matlab / Simulink. The simulation results show that the control method can effectively estimate the motor speed with small error and high tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Real-time transmission and configuration strategy of measurement data based on Newton's Law of Cooling
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: At present, with the deepening construction of the two-level data center of State Grid, there are more and more supporting applications. This paper mainly studies and solves the problems of rough data classification and poor transmission timeliness in the current real-time access transmission of measurement data, and puts forward a method of obtaining data priority by Newton's Law of Cooling, and using dynamic configuration strategy to carry out real-time transmission and dynamic configuration according to data priority. In order to effectively improve the data access quality of two-level data, give full play to the basic role of data as a factor of production, better serve business application and innovative development, and improve the accuracy of data classification and real-time transmission in real-time access and transmission of measurement data. Simulation experiment results show that this method can reduce the average waiting time of the data during the data transmission, and complete the data transmission early, which can effectively improve the timeliness of the data transmission.

articleTitle: Case Study: Predicting Future Forex Prices Using MLP and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This study compiles 10 years of past daily closing prices for numerous trading assets, and economic reports. The data will be used to train, test, and validate a variety of ANN and LSTM models. This paper introduces a learning window that trains the network using a predefined number of days in the past to predict several days' closing prices in the future. A search grid algorithm is used to select the optimal hyperparameters for the networks. The MLP network managed to achieve an accuracy of above 80% when 30 days of the previous closing price were used as input to the network.

articleTitle: A Reproducing-free Chip Power Supply Fault Monitoring Circuit Design
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid improvement of chip integration, chip power supply failure has become a very critical source of chip failure. Existing fault detection methods mainly rely on the measurement of related electrical characteristic parameters after chip faults are reproduced for fault location. However, as power supply faults are hard to be reproduced, it is difficult to locate power supply faults through existing fault detection methods. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a reproducing-free chip power supply fault monitoring circuit design that can monitor the external power supply signal of the chip without failure reproduction. Our design includes a comparator-based glitch and clock monitoring circuit and a time-to-digital conversion(TDC) circuit that calculates the glitch and reset time. The post-imitation test of the design shows that the circuit can support clock frequency in the range of 50MHz to 500MHz, and the accuracy of the measurable clock jitter accuracy is 5% *clock period (UI); it can measure glitches with a minimum of 20mV and a shortest duration of 0.5*UI, and fault with a reset time less than 4 *UI. This can successfully monitor most of the power supply fault. On the basis of post-imitation, we also tape out our design our design in real chip.

articleTitle: Research on Kill Chain Analysis Method Based on Template-Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As the whole process of attacking the enemy, kill chain plays an important role in system warfare of modern war. Starting with situation assessment, in order to solve the problems of strong data dependence, poor real-time performance and accuracy of Bayesian network situation assessment method based on template matching, this paper proposes a strike chain analysis method based on template Bayesian network. This method uses the template matching reasoning results to modify the Bayesian reasoning results, and uses the Bayesian network reasoning results to compensate the composite events in the template. It has excellent performance in real-time and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the structure of heterogeneous combat network based on improved Hete _ M community detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The research on the structural characteristics of Heterogeneous combat network (HCN) can provide an effective basis for its scientific organization and guarantee. The community structure analysis based on complex network can provide a powerful method for the research on the structural characteristics of HCN. In view of this, this paper put forward the idea of studying the structural characteristics of HCN based on community structure, and improve Hete_M community detection algorithm. In the experiment, different functional nodes are used as seeds to detect the community structure, which can provide reference for the node configuration of different functional elements. Meanwhile, the results show that the effect of dividing HCN structure with reconnaissance perception nodes as seeds is better, which provide a new idea for organizing HCN with reconnaissance perception elements as the core.

articleTitle: Civil Aviation Data Monitoring System Based on Encryptable Consortium Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the needs of civil aviation data sharing and a credible system building, this work designs a civil aviation data monitoring system based on an encrypted consortium blockchain. This system realizes data encryption on the basis of the consortium blockchain, which has the advantages of the blockchain while preventing the leakage of sensitive data. The data generated in civil aviation, including flight information, ground passenger services, aircraft maintenance information, and the hash value of monitoring multimedia files, can also be packaged on the chain in real time so that it cannot be tampered with and can be tracked. At the same time, data needs to be checked before uploading to determine whether there is any violations, so as to achieve real-time monitoring. The system can also choose whether to encrypt the data to be uploaded by means of data annotation. Finally, the system has been tested for performance and safety. Experimental results show that the system has low time cost and can resist multiple attacks.

articleTitle: Stackless KD-Tree Traversal For Ray Tracing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In ray tracing, the computation takes a long time due to the large number of rays and the complex target. In order to avoid invalid intersection calculation and speed up the intersection test between ray and target scene, the geometric information in space scene can be arranged by establishing KD-Tree (K-Dimensional tree) to speed up the intersection process. This paper proposes a stackless KD-Tree traversal based on ropes. By connecting the nodes of KD-Tree according to certain rules through “ropes”, a high-quality KD-Tree is constructed. In the process of ray tracing, the established ropes can be used to judge the KD-Tree nodes through which the rays pass. The results show that this method reduces the number of searching layers of KD-Tree compared with traditional methods.

articleTitle: Design of Low-Power Video Acquisition and Display System Based on ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This system is a new kind of video acquisition and transmission system based on the SoC FPGA platform, namely ZYNQ, with low power consumption. This system can be used quickly in different scenarios. The system also realizes the collection of video streams with two resolutions. The advantage of this system can also minimize the power consumption of the entire system. This system uses the IMX-222 camera to capture video data, and after the video processing module, the AXI-VWRITE module writes pixel data to the DDR3 memory through the HP port for storage. Finally, the pixel data is read by the AXI-VREAD module and is processed at the same time. Though the HDMI interface module, it will be displayed on the monitor. The experiment shows that the video acquisition and display system based on ZYNQ realizes the 1080P resolution 60FPS video image on the HDMI display and only the power consumption of the system is only 2.238w. It solves the problem of low resolution in the traditional embedded platform and deployment on some occasions. Besides this system can also work in an energy efficient state.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Link Embedding in Maritime Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The knowledge graph is essentially a multi-relational network, which uses a structured method to store the knowledge system of the corresponding relationships between entities in the real world. It is a structured representation of the real world and brings new technical means to the knowledge representation of the maritime world. However, the data is often incomplete, missing many nodes or links, because they may be only a small part of all based on credible facts. We can solve this problem by predicting missing links. Recent studies on multi-hop KGQA try to use relevant external text to deal with KG sparsity, this method still has relatively large limitations. In another study, a KG embedding method has been proposed to reduce KG sparsity by performing missing link prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis Model of Epidemic Speech based on BiLSTM and MCNN Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: An analysis model of epidemic speech based on BiLSTM and MCNN structure is proposed in order to know the news and information about COVID-19 in time and the views and focus of citizens on the situation. BERT pre-training model is used to extract word vectors, and then the information of bidirectional long-term and short-term memory network and convolution neural network models at different levels is fused. Finally, the speech is classified into two categories, and whether its emotion is positive or negative is calculated. Experimental results show that this model can better classify the polarity of speech emotion than the previous word vector model and the traditional neural network model.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Radar Active Masking Jamming Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the development of new system radar, the anti-jamming capability of radar has been greatly improved, which poses a serious challenge to radar jamming technology. This paper derives a coherent noise frequency modulation jamming method according to the shortcomings of high power of noise frequency modulation jamming. Meanwhile, for the problem that large time width and advanced jamming cannot be achieved, we further propose an advanced jamming method based on radar echo prediction. Simulation and test results show that the method can form effective jamming to radar echo signals and has good engineering application value.

articleTitle: A method of Avionics System for Fixed Wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: According to the reliability requirement for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), heterogeneous dual redundancy design is adopted to improve the reliability of avionics system. For UAV avionics system, serial port and low-speed bus interface are mostly used to realize interconnection, point-to-point connection between equipment, poor resource sharing, and poor reconfigurability and scalability of avionics system. An open avionics system architecture with multi bus structure is proposed, which solves the poor scalability of the typical RS422 star interconnection structure, improves the scalability of the system and meets the strong real-time requirements of avionics system.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks for Action Recognition with Adjacency Matrix Generation Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The proposal of Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) gives the neural network a better performance to understand graph structure data. Therefore, GCN has a natural advantage in the action recognition task. The traditional adjacency matrix was generated depending on the physical connection of human joints. It limits the ability of GCN to understand skeleton data. In this paper, we propose a new adaptive method to generate the graph adjacency matrix and a new GCN unit to process the adjacency matrix. A series of experiments have been implemented to verify the practicability and potential of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Lung nodule detection method based on improved YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of low accuracy and slow speed in current lung nodule detection methods, this paper proposes a lightweight lung nodule detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv4. The first is data preprocessing, such as resampling of the open-source data set LUNA16, lung parenchymal segmentation, etc. Then, based on the YOLOv4 network model, replace the original backbone feature extraction network CSPDarknet53 network with the Mobilenet-v3 network to speed up the detection of lung nodules. Use deep separable convolution block to replace the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\times 3$</tex> ordinary convolution in the enhanced feature extraction network structure, which greatly reduces the number of model training parameters. The K-means++ clustering method is used to replace the original K-means clustering method to perform cluster analysis on the data set, and 9 anchor boxes of different sizes suitable for lung nodule detection are obtained again. Finally, the improved YOLOv4 detection algorithm is used to detect lung nodules. The experimental results on the LUNA16 data set prove that the improved network model mAP value can reach 96.71%, and the detection speed can reach 41.99FPS. Compared with other network models, the experimental results prove that the improved network has better and faster detection results and is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on link load-balancing between marine LEO satellite constellations based on SDN
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: LEO satellite constellation architecture has been greatly developed in military and civil applications in recent years because of its flexibility and low transmission delay. For maritime operations, when it is far away from the ground base station, the most priority is satellite communication technology, and the characteristics of LEO satellites make it the first choice for maritime communication. However, due to the poor real-time and maintainability of the traditional satellite network, SDN technology is introduced in this paper. SDN is a new network architecture, which realizes the separation control of the data plane and the control plane. It can control the LEO satellite constellation network in real time in a programmable way, so as to obtain a better service guarantee. This paper studies the LEO satellite constellation system on the sea based on SDN technology. By analyzing the characteristics of SDN architecture and combining the characteristics of LEO satellite constellation system, this paper puts forward a feasible load balancing strategy, and uses the virtualization simulation tool to model and simulate it. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the throughput of inter satellite links, So as to improve the overall transmission efficiency of the constellation.

articleTitle: Information hiding algorithm based on depth projection of 3D model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor storage capacity and robustness of secret information in single-carrier information hiding algorithm, this paper proposes an information hiding algorithm based on 3D model depth projection. Firstly, principal component analysis (PCA) is used to standardize the origin and orientation of 3D model coordinate system, which makes 3D model affine invariant. Secondly, the hexahedral bounding box is established based on the feature vector of vertex covariance; Finally, the depth image of the processed 3D model on each surface is calculated according to the orthogonal projection rule, so as to construct the multi carrier information hiding area of the image. Through the circular analysis and partition DCT transformation of multiple images, the secret information is embedded in the DCT transformation coefficient to complete the information hiding. The experimental results show that, compared with the 3D mesh model based on a single carrier, this paper uses the 3D model to construct multiple embedding regions, which increases the possibility of redundant embedding and further improves the security and robustness.

articleTitle: READ-CSRL: Relation Entities Augmented Datasets for Conversational Semantic Role Labeling
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Some intelligent applications such as intelligent customer service, in-depth Q&A, chat bot, etc. need multiple conversation rounds, and there is a strong correlation between conversational sentences. Traditional Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) can only perform well on single-sentence tasks, however, the performances on tasks with multiple conversational sentences are unsatisfactory. Conversational Semantic Role Labeling (CSRL) was proposed for conversational tasks. Then knowledge enhanced CSRL was proposed, commonsense was introduced as external knowledge which is usually represented as a triple of request entity, relation and relation entity. Experiments show that after knowledge enhanced by full triples may bring some noise into the original input. So, in this paper, we propose a novel method to reduce the knowledge noise, and generate more augmented datasets enhanced with only relation entities. Experiments evidently illustrate that the proposed method outperforms the CSRL benchmarks. This provides a promising new way to fuse external knowledge in conversational SRL task.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Classification and Reliability Prediction Tool based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Reliability prediction is of great importance for electronic products design, and an indispensable technique to ensure that electronic components, equipment and the overall system meet their required reliability targets as well. Present methods, handbooks, standards and software tools of reliability prediction were studied and compared. For industrial and commercial electronic equipment applications, the development and demand of reliability prediction tools were analyzed in this paper. Using new-generation information technologies such as cloud computing and machine learning, a lightweight component reliability prediction tool was designed based on the Spring Cloud microservice architecture. In addition, the naive Bayesian algorithm was adopted to achieve intelligent components classification, which enhances prediction efficiency significantly. An example was offered, which verified the effectiveness of the cloud-based reliability prediction tool. Its characteristics of low-cost, rapidly-deployed and easy-to-use were shown, which differ it from traditional prediction tools, and make it suitable for commercial companies and electronic products.

articleTitle: Estimating the Number of Communities in Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Community structure is one of the important characteristics of complex networks. Community discovery has important theoretical significance and practical value. At present, accurate estimation of the number of communities is the key and difficult issue in community discovery. Inspired by the idea of Bayesian inference, this paper deduces the relationship between maximum possible partition and average mutual information and information entropy, and proposes a framework algorithm Number_Accurate_Estimation (short for NAE) and a concrete implementation to estimate the community number. Several typical algorithms for community number estimation are compared on several typical data sets, and experiments show the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Attribute attack graph generation method based on attack stage
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current attack graph generation method cannot cope with complex attack types and the data is missing, an attribute attack graph generation method based on the attack stage is proposed. Multi-stage analysis of the vulnerability of a single node can be used to simulate penetration more accurately. process. First, the vulnerability attack model technology and attack matrix division technology are used to infer the attack stage of the vulnerability; then, an attribute attack graph generation framework based on the attack stage is proposed; finally, simulation experiments are carried out through intranet data to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Discussion on Operational Reliability Test Scheme and Evaluation Method of Underwater Complex System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The operational mission profile of the underwater complex system is analyzed as a foundation. Combined with a variety of factors such as small sample, time and funds, this paper discusses three operational reliability verification test schemes and evaluation methods of the underwater complex system. The application principles of various schemes are given. It provides technical reference for the reliability test verification and evaluation of the underwater complex system.

articleTitle: Factoring Gaussian Integers: A Quantum Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, we developed a quantum algorithm for factoring Gaussian integers based on Shor's Algorithm. It is one of the problems that are intractable for classical computers but are manageable for quantum computers. An efficient quantum algorithm for factoring is influential in the application of cryptography because a large portion of the current cryptographic schemes rely on the assumption that factoring is difficult. We also discuss potential generalizations of our algorithm to other algebraic integers.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Diversity Combining Techniques over Nakagami-m Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the performance of wireless communication system over Nakagami-m fading channel using different diversity combining techniques. Among them, this paper adopts the following two principal types of combining techniques: Maximum Ratio Combining (MRC) and Equal-gain Combining (EGC). Variable-controlling approach is used to control the different parameters (such as the number of diversity branches, Nakagami-m fading parameter), and by analyzing the bit error rate (BER) of the system, the influence of each parameter over the fading channel and diversity combining techniques on the system performance is analyzed.

articleTitle: SETOKEN:A secure protection mechanism based on service API for 5G network access token
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The introduction of new technologies, new mechanisms, and new architectures in 5G mobile communication system has made higher data rate, greater user capacity, and richer service provision possible. However, exploiting the reusability of tokens, malicious attacker can launch man-in-the-middle attack to obtain service illegally. In this paper, we propose SETOKEN, a 5G access token security enhancement mechanism. We grant the CA certificate to a trusted network function repository (NRF) and add digital signature, random factor and serial number in the token to defend against attacks. Moreover, we have optimized the usage of tokens in terms of efficiency. Evaluation results show the security and effectiveness of SETOKEN. Besides, the overheads introduced by SEAPP is acceptable.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of ECDH and ECDSA
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Elliptic curve cryptography is the current standard for public key cryptography and it is also promoted by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) as the best way to ensure private communication between parties. It can be used to create faster, smaller, and more efficient encryption keys. It allows to transfer keys using elliptic curve mathematics. Smaller key sizes mean smaller requirements for hardware units performing arithmetic operations on the required cryptographic protocols. The content of this paper is a comparison of time intervals of key processes in the creation of ECDH (Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman) and ECDSA (Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm) algorithms.

articleTitle: Improvement of Output Voltage Quality of Power Conversion System Based on Specific Harmonic Elimination
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Dead time effect leads to the output voltage distortion of power converter system, conventional methods rely on the judgement of current polarity. In this paper, a specific harmonic elimination method is proposed based on bandpass filter. The sixth harmonic component caused by dead time can be filtered out in d-q reference frame of voltage. Thus, the online adaptive compensation of dead-time effect can be realized, without using any parameters. The simulation results have proved that the proposed method has obvious effect on dead time compensation of power converter system, and the output voltage waveform quality is improved.

articleTitle: Intelligent Diagnosis of Pipeline Defects Based on Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to carry out effective defect diagnosis of in-service oil and gas pipelines to ensure the safe and stable operation of oil and gas pipelines, this article proposes a pipeline defect intelligent diagnosis method based on particle swarm optimization and extreme learning machine. First, extract the defect signal features to form a feature vector set; then use the particle swarm algorithm to optimize the extreme learning machine to obtain hidden node thresholds; finally, divide the feature vector set into a testing set and a training set, and use improved extreme learning The machine is used as a pattern recognition algorithm for defect pattern recognition. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively perform fault pattern recognition, with a recognition accuracy of 92%, and is suitable for intelligent diagnosis of pipeline defects.

articleTitle: A R-ASK OFDM Modulation and Demodulation Scheme Against Vocoder Compression
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Resisting the compression on signals by the vocoder of the network is a difficult point to achieve end-to-end secure voice communication. However, only the modulation algorithms for traditional GSM voice channels are available in the relevant fields. Most of these algorithms only pass simulation and cannot be applied to actual scenes. This paper proposes an anti-vocoder compression modulation algorithm that combines relative amplitude shift keying with orthogonal frequency division multiple. The data is modulated by the difference of the frequency domain amplitudes of adjacent subcarriers, with a modulation rate of up to 1.5 Kbps and good anti-compression performance. A synchronization frame header is also designed, which has good anti-vocoder suppression characteristics. After the actual network voice channel transmission test, the algorithm modulation error rate is less than 0.5%, and the restored voice has high intelligibility. The overall scheme can be applied to the instant messaging of mainstream network voice software and has practical application value.

articleTitle: Further Improvement of NR RRC Inactive for Small Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Currently the typical applications which are common to both smart phones and C-IoT equipment have periodic and infrequent small packet transmissions. RRC INACTIVE state as a new type of UE state targets to reduce signaling overhead and UE power consumption for infrequent data transmission. Since the RRC inactive State state had not supported data transmission until 3GPP Release 16, the UE has to resume the connection to transmit small data and be released to INACTIVE state subsequently. This results in unnecessary power consumption and signaling overhead. On this point, the small data transmission (SDT) during the INACTIVE state has been studied in 3GPP Release 17. In this paper, the performance of SDT is evaluated. The detailed design of SDT are analyzed in terms of subsequent transmission, cell reselection, timers and anchor relocation.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Health Detection Technology in Intelligent Elderly Care
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The intensification of population aging and change in family structure make it difficult for the traditional elderly care model to meet people's needs for senior care services. However, with the development of Internet of Things, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Health Detection and other technologies, the emergence of intelligent elderly care model brings an opportunity to improve the quality of senior care services. Through the combination of advanced science and technology with the traditional elderly care model, the intelligent elderly care model provides more healthy, comfortable, convenient and safe elderly care services. This paper mainly analyzes the application of health detection technology in the intelligent elderly care, and proposes the existing problems of home health detection products and their countermeasures, hoping to help the improvement of the intelligent elderly care service.

articleTitle: Fine-grained Fashion Clothing Image Classification and Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Fashion has been an important part of society and culture bringing different people together to celebrate their own individuality. The sheer volume of the different kinds of clothing available today brings to the foreground the issue of searching and finding products that match the likings of a customer in this massive proverbial haystack of products. To resolve this issue, we propose a solution to use transfer learning techniques to match products against a clothing image of the user's liking and provide links to these relevant products. The user is allowed to input an image of a clothing apparel and search for related links without having to enter text input.

articleTitle: Disruptive Information on Social Media: A Perspective of Information and Communications Technology Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The word “Disruptive” is a very popular word in science and technology at present. Undoubtedly, Disruptive Information also has been changed into a very important conception in the Information and Communications Technology. Every second, a huge amount of data information is coming from the social media of the mobile terminals. Misinformation, disinformation, mal-information, anti-information, fake news and other disruptive information fill social media. As a result, governments, social communities, economic groups and individuals are scattering rich, colorful and disruptive information on social media and portal websites, which have profound economic, political, cultural, social and historical implications. The wide spread of disruptive information on social media would lead to various characteristics mixing up true or false, intentional or unintentional information. Disruptive information, as a very powerful resilience, could not only greatly stimulate the participants' imagination, cohesion, mobility and creativity, but also easily affect their judgment and understanding. Furthermore, disruptive information could also cause belief and trust crisis, leading to blind obedience, confusion, and mental breakdown. This research shows that it is very necessary to establish a traceable identification system, setting an early warning mechanism, publishing special disruptive information report, so as to improve the reporting system of social media platform.

articleTitle: Reading Method of Physical Characteristic Data of RFID Radio Frequency for Wireless Perception
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: RFID technology has been widely used in identification and positioning, with the deepening of its application study, researchers found that the technology can also be used to achieve wireless perception, and the acquisition of physical characteristic data such as phase angle, RSSI and Doppler frequency is the key and premise to realize wireless perception. However, at present, there is no report on the methods of reading the physical characteristic data of these RF signals. In this work, based on the widely used Impinj Speedway R420 system, we firstly discussed the RFID system architecture and the Low Level Reader Protocol (LLRP) protocol, and then we explain the connection and configuration between the reader and the host, as well as the configuration of the eclipse development environment. Moreover, we also give a program algorithm for reading those physical characteristics data of the RF signal. Finally, authors put forward the method of improving the reading accuracy, and give the use of experimental data is discussed comprehensively.

articleTitle: Research on Data Link State Awareness Based on Buried Point
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the construction of the two-level data center of the State Grid, there is a lack of awareness of the data link status of the two-level data center. This paper presents a research on data link state perception based on buried points. First, the data link information is collected through the buried point probe, and the link information is reported by the buried point, combined with random forest regression to analyze the network abnormality, and complete the current link state perception.

articleTitle: Designing Evaluation Indices for Joint Operation Systems Base on Random Forest with Generalized Linear Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Joint operation system is a typical complex system with nonlinear, emergent properties and diversity. Traditional capability index selection methods cannot describe the capability of the joint operation system objectively and accurately because of the subjectivity and randomness in the process of selection. Here, the joint operation simulation experiment based on simulation deduction system is designed, and the assembled machine learning model is built, the Random Forest with Generalized Linear Regression algorithm, to farm the multidimensional and holographic operation data deeply. The random forest algorithm model is used to deeply mine the “multi angle and full dimension” confrontation data obtained from the simulation experiment to screen the significant basic parameter indexes of joint operation strike-capability, and on this basis, the quadratic linear regression is carried out. Finally, the important target threat index of joint operation system, which reflects the complex characteristics of joint operation system, such as operational uncertainty, adaptability and emergence, is constructed. It provides a feasible decision-making basis for the commander to adjust the operational plan in real time and evaluate and predict the plan.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of SD Card Storage Performance Based on MCU: Hubei Province environmental protection automobile oil pipe intelligent manufacturing enterprise and school joint innovation center
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In previous SD card-based data acquisition and processing experiments, due to the chain storage structure of FAT32 file system, SD card occurred data interspersion when collecting massive data, resulting in SD card storage errors Therefore, this design based on embedded microcontroller FDT FAT file system are realized by programming and DATA stored in order, and by increasing the number of DBR sector to achieve redundancy cycle in order to increase the service life of the SD card, at the same time the new SD card error detection and error correction function, can effectively enhance the SD card on huge amounts of DATA acquisition and processing of real-time and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on two-dimensional Sum-difference Network of phased array antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of microwave radiation antenna array for its feeding system, a new high-performance two-dimensional Sum-difference Network is designed. The two-dimensional Sum-difference Network consists of a sum and difference device, a Wilkinson power divider and a vertical transition of strip-line to SSMP. The sum port has the characteristics of equal amplitude and phase with port 24 outputs; The pitch difference output port has the characteristics that the amplitude of the upper part and the lower part is equal and the phase difference is 180 degrees; The azimuth difference output port has the characteristics that the amplitude of the left half and the right half is equal and the phase difference is 180 degrees. The simulation optimization design and processing test of the network in K-band are carried out. The simulation and test results agree well. The test results show that the network has good two-dimensional Sum-difference Network characteristics, the reflection coefficient is better than 13dB, and the insertion loss is better than 19.4db.

articleTitle: Weighted mapping of contaminated areas based on satellite
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Excessive electrical fouling can lead to the failure of insulation devices and affect the reliable operation of the grid. Wide-area measurements using field sampling and online monitoring methods suffer from high acquisition costs, while their assessment results are also highly subjective. In this paper, a study of satellite remote sensing-based mapping of pollution areas is carried out in Yunnan Province, China, as an example. A remote sensing-based map of the entire Yunnan province is obtained using a machine learning approach, taking into account various air pollution data, emission inventories and meteorological data. The remote sensing-based map and the manual measurement-based map were combined with corresponding weights to obtain a weighted map of the polluted area.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Teaching Design for Knowledge Points Labeling by Education Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the in-depth integration of information technology and human life, the Internet has gained rapid popularity, and global data shows the characteristics of explosive growth and massive aggregation. The outbreak of COVID-19 makes online learning popular and universal. Different from the traditional way of education, online learning allows learners to have access to complexity and diversity as well as varying levels of knowledge mastery. For the current mainstream personalized education, making good use of education data for learning analysis is an important direction to solve the problem. This paper finds that learning platform has just begun to rise on a large scale, but there are still some problems, such as the confusion of learning resources, the unreasonable setting of the question bank and the unclear classification of the difficulty of knowledge points. Most of the platforms do not divide the knowledge points and difficulty of the questions, therefore, students cannot find the key points, and some of them fill in the difficulty directly according to subjective judgment, which is not scientific nor objective. This paper analyzes students' historical answer data, classifies and divides the difficulty of knowledge points by clustering algorithm, then verifying it on the Istudy education platform which is developed by our laboratory. The experimental results show that this labeling system is more objective and effective, contributing to improving the efficiency of online learning. For students, they can adjust their own learning plans while understanding the difficulty of knowledge points. Teachers can also modify their teaching focus and assist the teaching design according to the difficulty classification of knowledge points.

articleTitle: Bridge Relation Extraction: New Chinese Dataset and Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As a transportation infrastructure, bridge plays an important role in the region connectivity and urban prosperity, and brings tremendous convenience to people's daily life and travel. The operation and management systems of bridges are more convenient owing to the popularization of artificial intelligence. Specifically, knowledge bases in bridge field not only contribute to the intelligent management and maintenance of bridges but are conducive to enhancing the efficiency of operation decisions. One of the predominant methods to construct knowledge bases automatically is relation extraction which aims to extract structured information from unstructured texts. There are, however, two major challenges in bridge relation extraction study: 1) no bridge-specific dataset for this task; 2) no specific relation extraction models for bridges. In this paper, we introduce a manually-crafted Chinese dataset called Bridge-RE for bridge relation extraction and propose an excellent model called BERT-Bridge that can extract the relations effectively from the sentences in bridge field. Specifically, we carefully select 2500 sentences from the PDF format articles which are strongly related to bridges. The entities and relations in sentences are annotated manually and the subjects of Bridge-RE are components, defects and maintenance methods about bridges. Furthermore, we intensively investigate BERT-based models and make a considerable improvement on bridge relation extraction task by appending entity information to the model's input. Experimental results have demonstrated that our model obtains better performance than baseline model on Bridge-RE dataset.

articleTitle: Influence of migration sites on electronic structure of N, O, P and S doped graphene nano-flake systems
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The Density Function Theory (DFT) calculations have been carried out to study the effect of single nitrogen, phosphorus, oxygen and sulfur doping migration track along the center to corner and the center to edge, respectively, in the circumcircumcorone system (C96H24). From calculated spin splitting energy, it's found that the low spin state is more stable configurations for all doping sites in all four kinds of dopants. In order to clarify the effect and relationship of different migration sites on the electronic structure properties, the formation energies of different sites are analyzed, along with spin splitting energy and HOMO-LUMO gap. The results show that site −7 and 7 have lowest formation energy, while all doping sites have negative formation energy, with a specific symmetrical pattern. In addition, the HOMO and LUMO orbitals are investigated for all distinct 14 doping sites of the N, O, P and S dopants, along with analyzing the related properties, respectively.

Author Keywords: N, O, P and S dopants migration

articleTitle: Capital System vs. Information and Communications Technology: A Perspective of Civilization Development
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Information Civilization is the newest achievement of human civilization, which is characterized by information and communications technology. It is a transcendent development of the human civilization which dominated by the capital system. Information Civilization goes beyond the alienation, polarization and monetization in the capital system. It is widely opened a better social conditions and environments for society development and human civilization. Information Civilization has also increased the communication platform and integrate opportunity for other human civilizations. The capital system is based on commodity exchange, it, s a civilization that taking one-way communication as its development mode. Information Civilization is a civilization that is different from capital system, it is supported by information and communications technology. It provides a lot of new ways and opportunities for other human civilizations which are different from capital system. Information Civilization could enlarge the human boundaries of geography, country, nationality, language, custom and religion in many many ways.
