In the future Information Civilization, the non-capital system civilization, such as Chinese civilization and other traditional human civilizations with long history, is going to be integrated into the global civilization system with the help of information and communications technology. Furthermore, the non-capital system civilization is also going to enrich human civilization and lead human society to go happier, better and higher.

articleTitle: The research of text retrieval based on DeepCT and Conv-KNRM
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Text retrieval is the main means for people to obtain information from a huge text database. Current document retrieval methods do not consider the association between words and context, and cannot effectively retrieve information based on semantics. Aiming at the semantic feature extraction of text retrieval, this paper uses Bert, DeepCT and KNRM and its derivative model to improve the construction and feature extraction of similarity matrix, and proposes a text retrieval model based on DeepCT and Conv-KNRM. The goal is to give appropriate word weights to different keywords and improve the accuracy of text retrieval. In this paper, through experimental comparison, it is proved that this model improves the accuracy of text retrieval.

articleTitle: A Tibetan Error Correction Method Based on Syllable-Based Levenshtein Distance
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Accurately and effectively find and correct errors in Tibetan is of great significance to Tibet's informatization construction. However, due to the linguistic specificity of Tibetan, previous methods proposed for general Language were unable to accurately correct Tibetan errors. Consequently, in this paper, we present TEC_SLD, a Tibetan error correction method which is able to accurately identify incorrect syllables in Tibetan and provide candidate words to correct the errors. Exploiting syllable-based Levenshtein distances method, TEC_SLD calculate the edit distance between two strings with syllable as the smallest unit. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with the traditional Levenshtein distance method, the average hit rate of TEC_SLD proposed in this paper is 70.9% higher. And the first hit rate of TEC_SLD achieves up to 18x increment.

articleTitle: Threat Intelligence Disclosure Trend Analysis Model Based on Time Series
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In recent years, the number of malicious attacks on the Internet using threat intelligence information has increased dramatically. It is necessary to establish a scientific threat intelligence trend prediction model, predict and analyze the time trend of threat intelligence, and provide decision support for the formulation of targeted network security protection strategies. In order to achieve more accurate network security measures, integrated with Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model and Generalized AutoRegressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) model, this paper proposes a selection algorithm based on normal testing. Under the premise of retaining data sequence characteristics, according to data, more normal tests are provided to make data more accurate predictive threat information trends. A predictive model based on selection algorithms is proposed to predict the time trend of threat intelligence and enhance the dimension of network security defense. Experiments have proved that the prediction model based on the selection algorithm has higher accuracy and real-time performance in threat intelligence data prediction.

articleTitle: Design of low profile high gain antenna loaded with artificial magnetic conductor
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's radio system technology, antenna, as an important signal transceiver, has higher requirements in research and design. At the same time, with the development of electromagnetic metamaterials, artificial electromagnetic materials with periodic structure have been widely used. A low profile, high gain antenna is designed based on the high impedance and in-phase reflection characteristics of artificial magnetic conductor (AMC). The upper layer of the antenna is a reflective cladding loaded with AMC structure, and the lower layer is a rectangular microstrip patch antenna loaded with AMC array. At the same time, the Fabry-Perot resonant cavity principle is used to separately adjust and control the reflection phase of the reflective cladding and the ground plate, so as to realize the low profile design of the antenna. In addition, combined with the multilayer process of low temperature co-fired ceramics (LTCC) technology, miniaturization is further realized. The simulation results show that the proposed antenna covers Ka band, and the center frequency is 23GHz. Compared with the original antenna, the profile of the antenna is reduced to 1.5mm, which is one-ninth of the operating wavelength. In addition, the peak gain of the antenna reached 11.53dB, an increase of 5.98dB.

articleTitle: Blind Equalization Algorithm based on Brainstorming Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of normal mode blind equalizer to deal with inter-code crosstalk, a blind equalization algorithm based on brainstorming algorithm is proposed. The algorithm starts with the problem of unsatisfactory initialization of the equalizer, and uses the brainstorming algorithm to quickly and accurately find the advantages of the global solution, reducing the initial mean square error of the system;on this basis, from the perspective of the convergence speed and convergence stability of the weighing instrument, the adaptive ability of the variable step error function is used to improve the equalization effect of the equalizer. Experimental results show that the new equalization algorithm can reduce the initial mean square error, accelerate the convergence speed of the equalizer, and improve the communication performance of the system.

articleTitle: FlexIPS: A Keep Tracking Scalable Network Function Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: From the past to the present, network attack methods have not been unchanged. As network technology is becoming increasingly complex, the difficulty of preventing risks has also increased. Attack methods have ranged from early packet spoofing, flood attacks, vertical scanning, to social attacks, such as horizontal scanning and spam. Up to the recent web application attacks, web injection attacks, penetration attacks, and ransomware that caused a large amount of economic lossesnot long ago have forced computer scientists to pay attention to the prevention of information security incidents. Intrusion prevention systems (IPSs), also known as intrusion detectionand prevention systems, are used for maintaining network security. Their purpose is to reinforce the deficiencies of network firewalls and network intrusion detection systems and strengthen network safety. IPSs can monitor the network status and transmission behavior of network packets inreal time and interrupt, adjust, or isolate abnormal or malicious network packet transmission behaviors in real time. In this study, a scalablesoftware-based IPS based on Hy-perscan, Data Plane Develop Kit (DPDK), and OpenNetVM is designed and implemented. With these libraries, it achieves a dynamic scalable IPS that can filter out malicious patterns spread all over the packet flow. Moreover, a methodcalled back pressure is designed and implemented to increase the performance of the IPS. Finally, the performance of the IPS is evaluated on a 10-Gbps network environment using iperf, Pktgen-DPDK, and malicious pcap files with Snort community rules.

articleTitle: Security Classification Of Bank Data Based On NLP
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern information technology, the world has entered a new era of big data. In order to effectively protect the security of bank data assets and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of customers, commercial banks need to carry out security grading of the data they manage and need to strictly regulate the data security grading elements, data security impact assessment and data security level change within the objectives, principles and scope of data security grading. The process of data security classification is continuously improved in all aspects. This project is based on natural language processing technology, using Python language to implement data security grading, reducing the tediousness of manual grading, but also ensuring data security.

articleTitle: An air filtration performance prediction method of gas turbine based on Dynamic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As an important part of the gas turbine, the air quality assurance system has a profound impact on the performance of the whole unit. In order to ensure the normal operation of the gas turbine air quality assurance system and improve the maintenance level, the air filter system is used as the research object. In this work, dynamic neural network is utilized to construct a performance prediction frame of the air filtration. The dynamic network not only depends on the current network input, but also depends on the current or previous input, output, and state. In addition, feedforward structure is designed to improve the prediction performance of the network. The air filtration system was arranged and the data was collected to prove the effect of proposed method. The results demonstrate that calculation based on dynamic network model and air filtration prediction model based on time series are effective.

articleTitle: Stereo Image Inpainting for UGVs Based on a Multistage Feature Alignment and Refinement Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The binocular vision systems provide a wealth of visual information for UGVs. However, the dust, soil and water droplets in the environment can easily contaminate the camera lens, which will cause errors in the robot's visual perception system. However, the current GAN-based image inapinting methods usually generate wrong textures, which are quite different from the real scenes. To address this problem, we propose an inpainting method that uses stereo image information as prior knowledge. In this work, we first use a multistage feature alignment module to align the left and right feature maps, and use the dynamic fusion module to fuse the two features after each alignment stage. After that, we use the feature refinement module to refine the texture information of the feature maps to generate more refined details. Experiments show that our method surpasses previous work, and achieves a higher PSNR and SSIM evaluation metrics while running over 25 fps on single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti, which provides effective self-inpainting capabilities for the binocular vision system of UGVs to keep driving safety.

articleTitle: Answer-Agnostic Question Generation in Privacy Policy Domain using Sequence-to-Sequence and Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper presents a transformer and sequence-to-sequence mapping approach, augmented using relevant named entities, towards generating questions for text understanding in the domain of policies (such as privacy agreements). To date, most work in question generation has used general-purpose benchmarks such as the SQuAD corpus; however, the application of question generation to document understanding has largely omitted use cases in the privacy policy domain. A privacy policy is a legal document that clearly divulges the policies of an organization regarding the gathering and usage of customer data. Reading and understanding privacy policies to gain a measure of the rationality of terms of service before accepting them is of critical importance to users. However, users frequently ignore these policies or base their decisions on insufficient understanding of the “fine print” due to the complex language and excessive length of policies. This work focuses on building a question generation system to assist reading comprehension of privacy policies. This work can be used to improve the quality of question-answering systems in this domain, which consequently can help users understand the privacy policies before agreeing to them. This paper uses existing deep learning models like T5, which is a transformer model, and several sequence-to-sequence models to generate questions. Since, existing named entity recognition (NER) tools do not work in this domain, we also created our own named entity labels to add auxiliary information to our models. Adding the auxiliary information improves the results over the baseline models giving us a promising future direction to further add some constraints, as a means to add more background knowledge to our models to generate better quality questions.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for ADC Channel Alignment in Optical Signal Reception System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In the coherent optical transmission system, the analog-to-digital converter (ADC) plays an important role to transfer the analog signal into the digital domain for the subsequent processing, but there may be mismatch and affect the signal quality, so channel synchronization is essential in the system. This article presents a method to synchronize the 4 ADCs, we use the pseudo-random binary sequence (PRBS) code to detect the mismatch in the descramble process, and feedback asynchronous information to the relevant register, the random-access memory (RAM) outputs different bits depending on the address of the feedback, after several iterations and adjustments, 16 channels are aligned, ADC is able to sample at the same time interval, lays the foundation for subsequent dispersion compensation, modulation format identification and decision. Such method does not need additional circuits, the structure is simple and the convergence is fast, work in the background mode, there is no impact on the ADC conversion.

articleTitle: Research on Security Apparel Recognition Technology Based on Multiple Scene Perception
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a SEBYOLO security apparel recognition model for the problem of construction workers not wearing security apparel in multiple scenarios. The model network weighs the different channels of the feature map and integrates the attention mechanism and the multi-layer feature network. Firstly, the model makes full use of the idea of features and strengthening small target detection to improve the feature extraction network. Secondly, an attention mechanism is introduced to improve the feature extraction ability and detection accuracy of the model. Secondly, the attention mechanism is introduced to improve the feature extraction ability and detection accuracy of the model. Taking into account the small targets of the head and the helmet, this paper further optimizes the feature scale of the feature fusion layer and the multi-scale detection layer, so that the detection model can better adapt to small targets. Finally, a comparative experiment was carried out on SEBYOLO and other detection models, and an ablation experiment was set up to comprehensively evaluate the model, verify the effectiveness of the model, and better reflect the performance of each network in the model. The experimental results show that the SEBYOLO model has improved accuracy, recall, and mAP compared to other detection models. In multiple scenarios, the accuracy of the model in detecting security apparel is 0.955, which can achieve accurate detection of security apparel targets.

articleTitle: Reliability Simulation Technology Research and Interface Development Based on Multiphysics Coupling and Physics of Failure
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As an important part of reliability simulation, physics of failure simulation technology has been widely used in complex systems in aviation, aerospace, electronics, electromechanical and other fields in recent years. However, in the application process of current physics of failure simulation software, single physics simulation results are often used for calculation, which has a certain deviation from the actual conditions. After a thorough investigation of the multiphysics coupling simulation software and physics of failure simulation software, this paper developed an interface between the multiphysics coupling simulation software and the physics of failure simulation software based on a software called CARMES, which was independently developed by the Fifth Institute of Electronics of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. Then, a certain type of controller was used as an example for application verification. The verification results showed that the application of multiphysics coupling simulation helped to find more potential weak points and improve the credibility of the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of An Experimental Platform for Online Monitoring of Mine Water Based on The Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Based on the water quality changes in the mine water treatment process and the water quality requirements of the water points in mine production, a comprehensive utilization pathway for mine water was added and a water balance was constructed. In order to realize the above comprehensive utilization pathway for water supply, the IoT framework to meet mine water treatment was analyzed, and an online monitoring system for mine water was studied and designed. The system simulates the surface-underground mine water efficient utilization water treatment process, and was able to realize online monitoring of water quality and quantity information, and realize mine water scheduling through wireless control of multiple pumps. Experimental test results show that the system was able to quickly and centrally monitor various types of information at the water supply and water consumption points throughout the water treatment process and can simulate actual production for wireless scheduling. The results of this study can provide experimental and validation tools for the study of strategies for the efficient use of mine water.

articleTitle: Research on the Efficiency of Educational Expenditure in Ganzi Prefecture Based on DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper uses DEA evaluation method and cluster analysis method to evaluate the education expenditure efficiency of the Ganzi Prefecture government from 2011 to 2020 and the education expenditure efficiency of the county-level governments in 2020. It is noted that the educational expenditure efficiency of Ganzi Prefecture has been decreasing in scale since 2017. Pure technology efficiency has made it difficult to improve the synthesis technique efficiency of public education expenditures of the Ganzi Prefecture government. The education expenditure efficiency of the county-level governments of Ganzi Prefecture is not only affected by pure technology efficiency, it is also affected by scale efficiency. It is suggested to improve the service management level of the Ganzi Prefecture government and optimize the allocation of educational resources within the Ganzi Prefecture.

articleTitle: A Cascade Binary Tagging Joint Extraction Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Extracting entities and relations from unstructured text has become a significant task in natural processing, especially knowledge graphs. However, the traditional relationship extraction method processes this task in a pipelined manner, i.e., identifying entity first and then recognizing their relations, and rarely consider the relevance and independence of the two subtasks. To solve the problems of error accumulation, we present a jointly learning method to a tagging problem to tackle this problem. Meanwhile, to understand the semantics of sentences, we introduce the pre-training method into our models, such as BERT. To solve the problem of entity overlap, we replace softmax with a sigmoid activation function. In the language and intelligent technology competition, experimental results show that our model outperforms the baseline model.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Low Noise Receiving System with Hybrid Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Multi-port network structure widely exists in the receiving system of phased array radar. The accuracy of multi-port network noise coefficient calculation directly affects the performance of the receiver system. Based on the multi-port network model, the noise figure calculation of the receiving system with matrix switch is optimized to reduce the calculation error. On this basis, the receiving system of offset paraboloid hybrid antenna is studied. The noise figure and antenna pattern under different channel numbers are simulated to obtain the receiving characteristics of low-noise hybrid antenna.

articleTitle: Cellular Automata based Adaptive Clustering Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Clustering is a popular machine learning approach, and research on clustering is always a hot spot. A cellular automata based clustering is proposed in this paper. Cellular automata is introduced to model the comparison between entities and the forming process of the clustered groups. In this approach, entities that needs clustering could be placed into the different cells in the initial phase. In the clustering forming process, the entities in a specific cell could compare with the entities in the neighboring cells. The next action of entities in the cell could be made according to the situation in and around the cell. The similar entities would be moved to form groups. Simulation and experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: SAR Repeater Jamming Detection Method Based on Circle Frequency Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) repeater jamming destroys the quality of SAR images and causes a large number of false alarms and missed alarms for SAR target detection. In this paper, the imaging characteristics of the jamming are analyzed for the two typical repeater jammings of SAR Interrupted Sampling Repeater Jamming (ISRJ) and Micro Motion Jamming (MMJ), and a SAR repeater jamming detection algorithm based on Circle Frequency Filter (CFF) is proposed. The feasibility of the algorithm is theoretically analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified based on the real SAR image with jamming.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Data Compression in Signal Correlation Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the digital signal has exponentially exploded, which brings tremendous pressure to data storage, transmission and seriously affects the efficiency of signal processing. This paper aims to the data compression in signal correlation processing. It is verified that Huffman coding, Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) can effectively reduce the data volume while maintaining the accuracy of the signal correlation results. For better application in practice, the influence of signal parameters on data compression is further researched. The experimental results show that the lossless compression method can compress the signal more than 3 times without correlation distortion, while lossy compression can reach a compression ratio of at least 20 on the premise of ensuring the accuracy of correlation. In addition, DCT compression results demonstrate that the compression performance of phase-modulated, higher signal-to-noise ratio, longer duration, and lower carrier frequency signal is better.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor image fusion based on low-rank feature and joint convolutional dictionary
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Multi-sensor image fusion has been widely used in target detection and recognition in autonomous driving. To improve the contrast and details of the target in the fusion image, this paper proposes a fusion method based on low-rank features and joint image features. This method first obtains the base layer and detail layer of the input image through low-rank representation, and then the proposed method uses joint convolutional dictionary learning to further extract the potential edge features of the detail layer, including similar features and different features. Finally, the feature fusion of different layers is realized through two different fusion rules. Experimental results illustrate that this algorithm is better than popular algorithms on general databases.

articleTitle: LDA-LPA: A Community Detection Method Based on Topic Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Community detection in complex networks is an important task in network analysis. And community structures in networks can be detected from many aspects. However, community detection based on topic model is rarely studied, and most of the existing community detection methods based on topic model are generally based on node or edge attributes, such as text information. In this paper, a novel community detection method based on topic model is proposed, which only requires the structural information of networks, and does not need node or edge attributes to be presented. In addition, this paper also proposes a new graph embedding method based on the neighborhoods of node, which is simpler and does not need the complicated training process. Experimental results show that the community detection method proposed in this paper is superior to most benchmark algorithms for community detection. In particular, on some datasets, the method proposed in this paper can achieve the division of normalized mutual information of 1.0, that is, completely correct community division results can be obtained.

articleTitle: Chromatic Dispersion Monitoring for Long-haul 28 GBaud PDM-QPSK Optical Signal based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: A CNN-based neural network for chromatic dispersion monitoring method is proposed in this paper, named OptInception. It adopts the parallel structure for convolutional layers with different sizes. Experimentally, the mean absolute error and root-mean-squared error of estimation on 28 GBaud PDM-QPSK optical signals are below 0.1% with less than 32,000 ps/nm of residual chromatic dispersion. The effects of OSNR and signal power on estimation performance are investigated in experiment as well. In general, the proposed method presents high accuracy, robustness and adaptive characteristic in practice.

articleTitle: Text hashing by semantic information based on BERT model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Text hashing transforms a text into a binary hash code, and similar texts correspond to similar hash codes. By using text hashing, we can accelerate the similarity retrieval of text in big data environment and reduce the storage costs. In view of most existing text hashing methods having not integrated contextual semantic information into hash codes, a text hashing method based on BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers) model is proposed in this paper. Firstly, feature sentences are selected from the text, then the BERT pre-training language model is used to get the feature vector of each feature sentence, next, the weighted feature vectors are summed and binarized to obtain the text hash code. Experimental results show that both the precision and the recall rate of the proposed method outperform other text hashing methods

articleTitle: Modeling Semantic Inspired by Quantum Composite System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially for many specific tasks, representing and modeling semantic of text plays essential role. Generally speaking, by extracting feature of words, we can find the internal relationship between words and model text semantics. Further more, there have been achievements in using quantum concepts to construct language models, which suggests the effectiveness of applying quantum theory to semantic learning and representation. However, in the current research of quantum-inspired language model, semantic of the text is often directly modeled by quantum concept (e.g., density matrix), which blurs the original meaning of the word itself. In this study, we propose the composite semantic system (CSS) hypothesis and construct a quantum-inspired semantic representation network (QSRN). We apply QSRN to four different text classification tasks, the experimental results show the effectiveness of the algorithm and verify the hypothesis we proposed.

articleTitle: An Adaptive step size Stokes Space method for polarization demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper studies the polarization demultiplexing technology in the coherent detection of 100G DP-QPSK optical signals. An Adaptive step size Stokes space method for polarization demultiplexing is proposed, which solves the problem of insufficient convergence caused by the constant step size of the Iterable Stokes space method. The original Iterable Stokes space method has no singularity problem, fast convergence speed and better polarization state tracking performance, but its iterative step length is fixed. When setting the step length, it is necessary to find a balance between the convergence speed and the convergence stability. In this paper, the Iterable Stokes space method is improved. The new algorithm proposed retains the advantages of the Iterable Stokes space method and realizes the adaptive update of the step size. The simulation results show that compared with the Iterable Stokes space method, the proposed new algorithm adds a small amount of operations, but the convergence speed is doubled, the convergence is more stable, and the polarization state tracking performance is also improved.

Author Keywords: Adaptive step size Stokes Space method

articleTitle: A Frequency Domain CFAR Detection Algorithm Based on Morphological Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: To improve the robustness of frequency domain detector, and reduce the number of controllable parameters, on the basis of discussing the statistical characteristics of digital channelized receiver, a frequency domain constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detect algorithm based on morphological filters is proposed. The algorithm combines digital channelized receiver with morphological filtering CFAR detector, which can accurately detect narrowband signals when there are signal components in the reference unit, and reduce the number of controllable parameters of the algorithm. Compared with other algorithms, the proposed algorithm has better detection performance under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Improving Discriminative Entity Retriever with Generative Tasks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Entity retrieval, which aims to retrieve a subset of candidate entities from massive KBs for each query, is essential for many entity-centric tasks, e.g., question answering and entity linking. Most of existing methods address this task using a discriminative model by formulating it as as a matching problem between the query and each candidate entity. Recent progress show that the generative model, which directly generate entity names in an autoregressive way, can obtain competitive results against discriminative models. These two types of methods model the interaction between queries and entities in different fashion, where both of them have distinct advantages. In this work, we attempt to join the discriminative and generative modeling to leverage the benefits of both. Specifically, we develop a framework to jointly train a text generative model and a discriminative retrieval model, we use two-tower structure to encode queries and entities respectively, and use Bert as our encoder. Our model achieves 0.14 improvement in NDCG@10. And we compare the results of our model with the model without generative model, and the experiment proves that the generative model is effective.

articleTitle: Analysis framework of pollution related factors in power grid based on Aprior algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Grid fouling is a major hidden danger that affects the normal operation of the grid. Electricity fouling level assessment is of great significance to guide the cleaning work. However, there are too many factors affecting the fouling level, resulting in too many variables introduced into the modeling work, which makes the work more difficult and reduces the prediction accuracy. In this paper, we propose to use the Aprior algorithm to evaluate the importance of each input variable and simplify the subsequent set of input variables through data mining techniques. The results show that pollutant kernel density, pollutant distance, and land use type are important factors. Precipitation and wind speed are secondary factors. Atmospheric pollutants are equally important factors, which are also influenced by the previous three important factors.

articleTitle: An PM2.5-driven parametric adaptive ESDD prediction model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: ESDD is the main cause of high voltage transmission line ESDD and flashing accidents, and it is of great importance to study the accumulation law of insulator ESDD. The existing ESDD prediction model assumes that the rate of ESDD accumulation is a relatively constant quantity, and the observed data show that this assumption does not hold true in China. The rate of ESDD accumulation is closely related to the air pollution, and our study establishes the relationship between the rate of ESDD accumulation and the particulate matter 2.5 (PM2.5). The dynamic prediction model of dirt accumulation was constructed on this basis, and the idea of data assimilation was introduced to complete the parameter optimization estimation. The experimental results show that the model can not only describe the dynamic change law of the equivalent salt density well, but also make more accurate and stable prediction of the equivalent salt density. Considering the easy accessibility and large wide coverage of PM2.5 data, the proposed model is expected to significantly reduce the cost of regional ESDD assessment.

articleTitle: A Chinese Document-level Event Extraction Method based on ERNIE
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Event extraction is a key technology in natural language processing and has strong application prospects for extracting knowledge from unstructured data. The current event extraction technique is mainly based on sentence-based event extraction, which has the disadvantages of incomplete coverage of extracted events and ambiguity in event classification. In this paper, we propose the ERNIE-BiGRU-CRF model for chapter-level event extraction, which encodes the semantic enhancement of paragraph text by ERNIE pretrained language model, inputs a bidirectional gated neural network for feature extraction, and finally obtains the annotated sequence by CRF layer. In this paper, we perform event extraction on the Baidu financial domain documen-level event extraction dataset using the sequence-labeled trigger extraction model and the sequence-labeled event element extraction model, and the results show that the final model's F1 value is 5.45 percentage points higher than the baseline model.

articleTitle: Precise and scalable evaluation on the robustness metric of neural networks as classifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: It is well known that the minimum adversarial distortion associated with a specific sample x<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> reflects the local robustness of neural networks. However, it is intractable to solve the optimization problem related to the minimum adversarial distortion for general neural network cause it is non-convex. Works have studied the lower bound or upper bound of the minimum adversarial distortion to give a robustness metrics for neural networks, such as CLEVER score and CW attack. In this paper, we provide a formal robustness guarantee to transform the robustness analysis into two sub-problems: (1), compute out the maximum of the objective function g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> (r<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sup>); (2), generate a sequence {r<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf>} s.t. limn→∞ r<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf> is the minimum adversarial distortion for targeted attack. Based on this transformation, we propose an efficient and effective algorithm to directly estimate the instance-specific minimum adversarial distortion on the norm of the input manipulation required to change the classifier decision. Experimental results on two data-sets, MNIST and CIFAR, show that our measure of robustness is between the lower bound given by CLEVER and the upper bound by CW, indicating our approach gives a precise measure of the robustness of neural network. In addition, the powerful mathematical technique Extreme Value Estimation enables our algorithm computationally feasible for large neural networks. To the best of our knowledge, our algorithm is the first attack-independent approach to directly evaluate the minimum adversarial distortion as a robustness metric for neural network.

articleTitle: An Approach to Improve Distributed Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The coded distributed computing (CDC) proposed by Li et al. provides a high-efficiency method to decrease the communication load in most distributed computing frameworks. However, as there are more and more nodes, the numbers of output functions and input files in these CDC scenarios grow too fast to be applied in practice. In the course of our work, we make an attempt to significantly reduce the minimum requirement of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex>, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> denote the number of input files and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex> denote the number output functions in our proposed CDC scheme. The results indicate that the minimum requirement of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex> in our new CDC scheme is only a factor of the total number of computing nodes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$K$</tex>, and the minimum requirement of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> is far less than that of the optimal scheme provided by Li et al., while <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\frac{L_{new}}{L_{Li}}\leq 1.03125$</tex>, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$L_{Li}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$L_{new}$</tex> are the communication loads of the Li scheme provided by Li et al. and our derived CDC scheme, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the development mode of fashion select shop under the new retail format: Take LABELHOOD as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of the e-commerce market, online dividends are now decreasing, and offline physical retail is also facing a tough challenge of satisfying the increasingly diversified needs of consumers. New retail models and new retail scenarios have emerged as the market required. The article summarized the concept, characteristics and necessity of new retail, and combined with the development status of fashion select shop in China, taking LABELHOOD (A fashion select shop called Leihu LABELHOOD) as an example to explore the development model and transformation strategies of the select shop in the new retail format. With the upgrading consumption and the implementation of big data technologies, the emergence of new retail formats has broken the boundary between the traditional physical retail select shop and traditional buyer e-commerce platforms. The select shops use digital technology to drive marketing and combine online and offline models which are customer oriented. It has become an inevitable trend to focus on customers' immersive experience to promote transaction completion.

articleTitle: Knowledge map reasoning algorithm based on Weight
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Auxiliary triage is an important direction for the application of medical knowledge graphs. Entity reasoning is the technical difficulty to realize auxiliary triage. The existing methods mainly rely on entity reasoning algorithms based on subgraph extraction, which have the disadvantages of large calculation amounts and low accuracy. This paper proposes a weight-based entity reasoning algorithm. The method uses Naive Bayes to calculate the weight of the relationship between entities, and quantifies the local structural characteristics of the entity by calculating the purity of the entity and the correlation between the entities, and based on this to improve the subgraph extraction process to reduce the complexity of the algorithm. The experiment is based on the open-source medical knowledge map of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the patient data set provided by the partner hospital. The average time consumption is 0.252s, the additional storage consumption is 950KB, and hits@5 is 91.34%. At the cost of occupying a small part of the storage space, inference speed and accuracy have been improved.

articleTitle: Design of Maritime Unmanned Detection System Based on Multi-mode Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In maritime environment detection, the buoy-based detection system is widely used because of its simplicity and economy. And it can work all-weather, long-term and continuously in the harsh maritime environment, which becomes one of the most important means of maritime detection. A maritime detection buoy system is designed to achieve real-time detection and high-speed data transmission while ensuring low power consumption and reliability of the system and increasing the detection range. A multi-mode communication system scheme using distance and bit error rate as priority indicators to select communication modes for data transmission is proposed. The x86 industrial personal computer(IPC) and STM32 single-chip microcomputer are used as the control core, and the multifunctional information fusion measurement and control system is used as the upper computer software, and a study on the key process design of the unmanned detection system is carried out. The experimental results show that the system has a flexible communication method, reduces power consumption while ensuring the reliability of the communication effect, and the transmission distance meets the expected design requirements, which has a certain reference value for the design of other buoy communication systems in the future.

articleTitle: Case Recommendation Algorithm of Discipline Inspection and Supervision based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In view of work problems in the field of disciplinary and supervision such as the large number of cases, the complexity of the content of the documents, the large workload of data compilation, and the low efficiency of conviction and sentencing, intelligent recommendation of similar cases is an important measure to alleviate this situation. In order to improve the accuracy and interpretability of similar case recommendation, based on the constructed laws and regulations knowledge graph of disciplinary inspection and supervision and the disciplinary case dataset, an intelligent recommendation algorithm for similar cases that integrates the characteristics of the legal knowledge graph of disciplinary inspection and supervision is proposed. The method constructs a keyword dictionary of legal elements that map the keywords in the case text with the entities in the knowledge graph, and merges the knowledge features of the matched legal entities with the feature vectors of the original case text so that enhances the representation of legal knowledge characteristics corresponding to disciplinary. Experiments with several machine learning methods and deep learning methods show that the proposed method has a certain improvement in F-score.

articleTitle: Visualized Intelligent Management and Control Platform for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to improve the lean management level of distribution network production in an all-round way, the Equipment Department of Shanxi Company took the lead in building a distribution network visualization system to realize the active repair and operation of the fault/abnormal distribution transformer in the medium voltage substation. As the front-end display of distribution network visualization system adopts FLEX technology, it cannot support the display demand of large data volume in this project, and the business architecture focuses on the demand of operation and inspection, which cannot support the visual intelligent management and control demand of other departments. Therefore, in order to comprehensively improve the intelligent management and control of distribution network, a new visual intelligent management and control platform of distribution network is built. This project is based on the support of the data center, deeply integrates the distribution network frame and equipment, user files, operation data, monitoring data, environmental data and operation data, constructs a map of the power grid, and provides data sharing services; Realize distribution network operation information sharing, reduce internal management costs, and improve the security, stability and economy of distribution network operation.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of COVID-19 with Chest CT Scans using 3D Deep Learning model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: COVID-19 is breaking out and spreading globally, posing a severe threat to public health and economies worldwide due to its highly transmissible and pathogenic nature. Early, accurate and rapid diagnosis of COVID-19 can effectively stop the spread of the COVID-19 virus. Automatic diagnostic models based on deep learning can detect COVID-19 quickly and accurately. This paper uses a three-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (3D CNN) to build a COVID-19 diagnostic prediction model for COVID-19 detection. All 192 sets of chest Computed Tomography(CT) data collected are used for this study, including 96 sets of confirmed COVID-19 patients and 96 sets of CT scans of normal human lungs. 5-fold cross-validation is used to train and validate the model. 154 data sets are used to train the model, and 38 sets are used for testing. All experimental data are segmented using a pre-trained SP-V-Net to obtain 3D lung masks fed into 3D CNN for training and validation of the prediction model. In addition, to verify the accuracy of the model predictions and provide interpretability for medical diagnosis, we visualize the experimental results using Class Activation Maps(CAM) to localize the predicted disease regions. The results from several experiments show that the accuracy of our prediction model is 0.911, the Area Under Curve (AUC) 0.976, for no-COVID-19(Precision, 0.902, Recall 0.911, F1-Score 0.900), COVID-19 (Precision, 0.932, Recall 0.911, F1-Score 0.902). The experimental results show that our established diagnostic model can help physicians make a rapid and accurate diagnosis of COVID-19 in response to the spread of COVID-19.

articleTitle: MMC Equivalent Modeling Method of AC/DC Hybrid System Based on Model-Data Hybrid Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The conventional power system modeling methods have intrinsic disadvantages in representing unmodeled dynamics and ambiguous information. Specifically, the conventional modeling of converter valve usually ignores the high-frequency switching state. In order to break through the limitations of traditional modeling methods, this paper aims at giving an effective modeling strategy that can accurately describe the unmodeled dynamics and uncertainty of AC/DC hybrid interconnection systems. The validity of this method is enhanced by the model-data hybrid-driven modeling concept based on the digital twin. The proportional integral control link of voltage source converter (VSC) is modeled by the linearized mathematical method. The data-driven model of pulse width modulation (PWM) loop of VSC is trained and established by the time convolution neural network (TCN) algorithm, which can describe accurately the high-frequency switching state of switching device. The Simulation experiments on a real-world power grid demonstrate the high effectiveness of the proposed modeling method and the excellent performance of the hybrid-driven model.

articleTitle: Analysis of artificial intelligence industry based on grey correlation ‐‐ a case study of Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: During the two sessions in 2020, the central government listed artificial intelligence as the core of a new round of industrial revolution. This paper systematically combs the artificial intelligence industry in Tianjin, divides the industry into three layers by weighted Bayesian classifier, and uses the grey correlation model to study the total output value of Tianjin and the industrial output value of related artificial intelligence in Tianjin from 2017 to 2019. From high to low, the correlation degree with the output value of Tianjin is: technology layer, foundation layer and application layer. The results of grey correlation analysis in this paper are consistent with the enterprise strategic cooperation and development focus led by Tianjin municipal government, but the correlation degree does not reach the expected level. The reason lies in the unbalanced development of artificial intelligence industry and insufficient development. Tianjin should establish a professional big data management department, focus on the introduction of professionals, further cooperate with university enterprises, establish a big data information monitoring and management department, and make reasonable planning for the introduced industries in the park, so as to become a first-class smart city in China.

articleTitle: Contrastive Visual Representation Learning Enhanced with Knowledge Embedding for Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: We present CURLKG: CURL [1] enhanced with Knowledge Graph method. Inspired by knowledge graph embedding, environment states are represented as entities and actions are relations between knowledge entities in CURLKG. This knowledge embedding auxiliary task gives “similarity” a more precise measure compared with previous contrastive image representation learning models. Experiments are conducted in Deepmind Controal Suit environment and shows that CURLKG outperforms original CURL with a 1.29x performance gain at 100K environment steps. The main advantage of our model is simplicity and generality. CURLKG can be combined with any reinforcement learning model and no specialized network structure is used. CURLKG is the first pixel representation method inspired with the idea of knowledge embedding which is used as a supplementary constraint to contrastive learning.

articleTitle: Indoor Elderly Fall Recognition System Based on Target Detection and Self-attention Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the increasing aging of the society, a series of consequences caused by falls of the elderly have become a serious medical problem and a real social problem. Aiming at the fall behavior of the elderly, the research and development of human fall recognition technology has practical application value. This paper proposes a method to recognize human targets in indoor images using target detection technology, and then use the trained neural network based on Self-attention technique named Vision Transformer (ViT) to recognize the falling posture of the elderly. Firstly, the target detection model is optimized and trained for indoor scene, so that the model can accurately detect human targets in indoor scene; Next, the indoor scene human target image is preprocessed, and the indoor human pose image data set is constructed; Then, the data set is used to train the ViT depth network, and enable it to correctly classify five postures (standing, sitting, lying, bending and crawling). The experimental results show that ViT network achieves high accuracy and excellent generalization capacity for the above 5 human posture and can realize the recognition of elderly falls.

articleTitle: Bi-directional Joint Embedding of Encyclopedic Knowledge and Original Text for Chinese Medical Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Named entity recognition is a basic task in natural language processing and can be used for building knowledge graph. Named entities generally refer to the entities in the text that have a specific meaning or a strong reference. In medical area, a great deal of medical information exists in the form of electronic text and we can acquire valuable part by this method. In this article, we take extra knowledge information of medical encyclopedia into account and we associate the original text in the named entity recognition task with its encyclopedic knowledge to enhance the ability of entity recognition through the establishment of the connection and interaction of the joint-network. Based on this, (1) the attention distribution based on medical encyclopedia knowledge was generated with entity embedding and context information in the sentence, which can be directly used to generate encyclopedia knowledge subnet; (2) the bi-directional joint embedding model integrates knowledge subnet and text subnet into one network so that the connection between them are considered. We conduct experiments on tow electronic medical record datasets proposed by CCKS. The experimental result shows that our proposed method has achieved a better result.

articleTitle: Research on Visualization of Cable Laying Process of 3D Digital Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Based on the design concept of THREE-DIMENSIONAL design guiding construction, this paper carried out secondary development of three-dimensional design platform to realize the visualization of secondary equipment wiring, transmission path and secondary virtual loop. Through the visualization of equipment wiring in secondary screen cabinet in Revit STD-R platform electrical equipment THREE-DIMENSIONAL display scene, it was convenient for on-site construction personnel to connect wires. The cable laying path optimization scheme under the triple constraints of cable cost, cable channel space utilization rate and shortest path is adopted to achieve the triple objectives of cable laying path optimization, cost saving and reasonable space utilization rate. The physical path and virtual loop of secondary device signal transmission can be visualized. Field debugging personnel can obtain panoramic information about the receiving and receiving devices, connecting devices (such as switches and optical configurations) and transmission paths of required signals, improving the field debugging efficiency of virtual terminals and virtual links. And through the visual section of cable laying to achieve a single cable 3D path query, can intuitively see the overall cable layout effect and the actual situation of cable turning, comprehensive consideration of the path length, cable cost, cable trench space utilization and other factors, unreasonable cable laying adjustment.

articleTitle: Diversity Enhanced Image Captioning with Adversarial Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Image captioning aims at analysing image content and translating it in the form of natural language. The process of caption generation is the conversion process from image domain to text domain. Currently, the image captioning has made great achievement but in many case the generated image caption content is simple and lacks diversity. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a diversity enhanced image caption generation method by adversarial learning. The method proposed in this paper solves the problem by minimizing the difference between captions, while the intra-group difference and the inter-group difference are employed as the criteria to improve the diversity of generated caption. The method is optimized with generative adversarial networks framework. We evaluate the proposed method on the CUB-200 dataset with accuracy and diversity metric and the results shows that the proposed method could not only improve the diversity of generated caption but also ensure its semantic accuracy.

articleTitle: SSA-CFS:An Effective Feature Selection Method for Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The development of network has brought great convenience to our lives, but the number of network intrusions has also increased sharply at the same time. Intrusion detection system(IDS) is one of the most effective ways to solve this problem. IDS based on machine learning is an important issue of current research. Feature selection is a commonly used method in IDS to improve model accuracy and timeliness. In this paper, we propose a heuristic algorithm SSA-CFS based on SSA and CFS, and build a two-layer classification model based on this algorithm. We conduct experiments on the data set named NSL-KDD to evaluate the performance of the algorithm and IDS, and compare them with other traditional algorithms and models. The experimental results show that the feature selection algorithm and IDS model we proposed have significantly improved the time and detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Hardware acceleration scheme of Compressed Position Report based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: To solve the problems of poor real-time performance and high cost of complex test equipment structure of the existing implementation scheme of CPR coding in 1090ES data chain, an FPGA-based implementation method of CPR coding is proposed. The accelerated coding RTL circuit for single-precision floating-point data is designed using Verilog HDL, simulated by Altera-Modelsim, and compared with the traditional coding method to prove the advantages of the method in terms of computing speed and accuracy. The method is of great significance in improving coding efficiency, reducing device cost, and reducing size, and laying the foundation for specialized ASIC chip design.

articleTitle: Integrated Design Framework of Product General Quality Characteristics and Functional Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the current product development, such as the poor consistency of models and data, the gap between the design of general quality characteristics and functional characteristics, and the lack of systematicness of existing research, this paper studies the concept of integrated design of general quality characteristics and functional characteristics, defines the specific connotation of integrated design, and analyzes and studies the relevant elements of integrated design in combination with the product development process, builds an integrated design framework covering the whole process and characteristics of product development, clarifies the relationship between the elements of the integrated design framework from six dimensions, and as a according, a typical architecture of the integrated design software system based on the framework is given. Finally, take the development process of typical electronic system as an example, a general process of integrated design is given, which lays an important foundation for the implementation of integrated design and the promotion and application of related technologies.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Method of Zhuang Word Embedding Evaluation Set
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Word embedding is the first process to study the natural language processing. However, most of the researches on word embedding of minority languages, such as Zhuang language, lacks a word embedding evaluation method since the cost of manually constructing the test set of word embedding is high, and there are few minority language applications. In addition, the test set of word embedding of minority languages constructed by the traditional method usually lacks diversity. This paper proposes an improved sampling algorithm SPXY_Word to automatically create the comprehensive minority word embedding test set. Taking Zhuang as an example, we realize the automatic construction of the Zhuang word embedding test set Zhuang-Benchmark900. The experimental results show that the test set has balanced data, good discrimination between different word embedding models, highly similar evaluation ability with the Chinese test set: taking Pearson coefficient as the evaluation index, the similar evaluation ability of the two test sets is 97% in similarity evaluation and is 60% in relevance evaluation. This study provides a new solution for constructing a word embedding evaluation set for minority languages, which is helpful to slow the decline of minority languages and cultures.

articleTitle: Combining Minimal Surface Model with DGCNN for Natural Language Understanding
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Fine-tuning large pre-trained models is an adequate transfer mechanism in Natural Language Processing (NLP). However, it is challenging to serve in resource-restricted devices due to being computationally expensive. To reduce the trainable parameters of models while maintaining accuracy, we propose a novel geometry deep learning approach named Minimal Surface Model on DGCNN (MSM-D). In MSM-D, the minimal surface model is introduced as an adapter layer to convert the word vector into high-dimensional manifold data, an input to the point cloud model. MSM - D is empirically adequate and achieves close or even better performance of BERT-base on GLUE benchmark while being 5.7x smaller on inference.

articleTitle: Research on MIMO-SAR Imaging Based on Millimeter Wave Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: MIMO-SAR is a new radar imaging mode that has been proposed in recent years and has attracted much attention. It provides an effective way to solve the contradiction between high resolution and wide surveying bands faced by traditional synthetic aperture radars (SAR). In this paper, we overview the fundamental principle of MIMO-SAR imaging technology. Then, we establish a novel two-transmitter and four-receiver SAR imaging system based on linear frequency modulation (LFM) by combining multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technology with range Doppler (RD) algorithm to improve the imaging performance. Numerical simulation results are provided, which verifies that the MIMO-SAR imaging system has better imaging performance in terms of resolution and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: A network selection optimization algorithm based on AHP and TOPSIS in heterogeneous network environment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of network technology, heterogeneity is one of the main characteristics of future wireless networks. How to provide the best connection for end users is considered an important point. This paper, we designed a network selection optimization algorithm based on AHP and TOPSIS for possible mobile devices to improve the system's performance. Through supplying necessary parameters and conditions, the designed algorithm can automatically judge which network is the best one for the current task. This will be helpful for possible mobile devices to increase their efficiency.

articleTitle: Innovative Teaching Combined with 3D Printing Teaching Aids and OBE Teaching Philosophy
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: A pluralistic, efficient, and convenient teaching strategy was carried out to assist teachers and students for study. Conventional teaching methods can equip most students with rich theoretical knowledge, but we also ignore the significance of operational ability. We collected online questionnaires to analyze the demands of medical students for teaching aid model assistance, and compared the results of whether 3D printing was applied in teaching. The results show that the combination of 3D printing with OBE and Aesthetic education concept can not only cultivate students' innovative thinking and comprehensive skills, but also effectively stimulate students' interest in learning and improve the quality of teaching.

articleTitle: Research on performance prediction of gas turbine air filtration system based on transformation-gated LSTM method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The air filtration system is the only line of defense for outside air to enter the gas turbine. It is of great significance to study and predict the variation trend of air filtration system performance to ensure the safety, economy and reliability of gas turbine. In this work, the gas turbine air filtration system test is carried out, and the test data of fine filter differential pressure, ambient temperature and relative humidity are measured. Then the LSTM and transformation-gated LSTM (GT-LSTM) methods are utilized to predict the variation trend of air filtration system performance. Finally, the root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and symmetric mean absolute percentage error (SMAPE) are employed to evaluate the prediction effect quantitatively. The research results show that the RMSE, MAE, MAPE and SMAPE are only 0.0110, 0.0076, 3.3778 and 3.4655 by TG-LSTM method. The prediction error based on TG-LSTM method is smaller than LSTM method. Thus the prediction effect of TG-LSTM method is better than that of the LSTM method, and the TG-LSTM method is suitable for the performance prediction of gas turbine air filtration system.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Supply Chain Finance on Trading Enterprises and the Promotion of Financial Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: COVID-19 has a significant impact on the global supply chain, and enterprises involved in international trade may face more uncertainties. Financing constraints restrict the development of trading enterprises, while supply chain finance can help trading enterprises obtain more funds and reduce the risks in trade. This paper uses the data of trading enterprises from 2011 to 2020 and adopts cash-cash flow sensitivity model to study the relationship between supply chain finance and enterprise financing constraints. The results show that supply chain finance can significantly alleviate the financing constraints and reduce the cash-cash flow sensitivity of trading enterprises. In addition, this paper also puts forward suggestions from aspects of the government, financial markets and enterprises to promote the application of the information system of supply chain finance in international trade.

articleTitle: Efficient Hardware Implementation of Error Correcting Codes Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, we present efficient hardware structure of Gauss-Jordan Elimination Through Pivoting (GJETP) based error correcting code classification algorithm, in order to provide real-time solution for code recognition in non-cooperative context. We originality proposed to modify the architecture of traditional GJETP by using two type of processing units in the paper. Compared to normally used hardware architecture, the proposed hardware architecture based elimination algorithm significantly unleashes the working frequency and tightens the power consumption to a great deal. Further results illustrates that there are obvious acceleration using the proposed approach than software based method with the acceleration rate over 100 times.

articleTitle: Chinese Opinion Target Extraction Based on MRC Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, we formulate the Opinion target extraction (OTE) task as a machine reading comprehension (MRC) task. By formalizing the task of OTE as extracting answer spans to the question “Which opinion target is mentioned in the comment text?”, the prior semantic knowledge of the opinion target is introduced to improve the effect of OTE. We conduct experiments on the method proposed in this paper on pre-trained language models such as Bert and use the Lexical Analysis of Chinese (LAC) lexical analysis tool to correct the results predicted by the model. We conduct experiments on the Chinese evaluation object extraction datasets Baidu, Mafengwo, and Dianping, and the optimal F1 scores were 91.42%, 91.33%, and 93.72%, respectively. The experimental results show that the Pre-trained Model-MRC-LAC Model proposed in this paper can effectively improve the extraction effect of Chinese opinion target extraction.

articleTitle: Station Distribution Optimization Algorithm of TDOA Passive Location Based on Adaptive Matching Reconnaissance Area
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Station Distribution is one of the key problems affecting the accuracy of TDOA (time difference of arrival) passive location. In order to obtain the optimal positioning results in a given reconnaissance area, a station distribution optimization algorithm of TDOA location is proposed in this paper, which is adaptive matching the reconnaissance area. In this algorithm, the mathematical modeling of location error is firstly implemented, and then the cost function of location error is constructed in the reconnaissance area. On this basis, the adaptive differential evolution algorithm is carried to find the optimal station distribution to minimize the cost function. The simulation results show that compared with the classical station distribution methods, the station distribution produced by the proposed algorithm can be adjusted adaptively with the reconnaissance area, the TDOA location error is effectively reduced in the reconnaissance area, and more accurate positioning results are obtained.

articleTitle: Blind Chromatic Dispersion Estimation for Coherent Optical Communication Based on Amplitude Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, we design and prove a blind chromatic dispersion estimation (CDE) method based on the amplitude spectrum of the received signal modulus. Through numerical simulation, the proposed CDE method shows robustness to nonlinear effects and amplified spontaneous emission (ASE). Single carrier 28 GBaud DP-QPSK or DP-16QAM signals can be reliably estimated by scanning and searching only 1024 samples. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are verified in a variety of long-distance transmission system. The CD ranges from 1650 ps/nm to 33000 ps/<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> m, and the standard deviations are lower than 25 ps/nm. Compared with other CDE algorithms, the method based on amplitude spectrum has lower computational complexity and smaller standard deviation, and also has stronger tolerance in terms of transmission damage and nonlinear effects.

articleTitle: Trajectory optimization of interceptor missile based on hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Sequence quadratic programming and hybrid genetic algorithm are used to optimize the interceptor trajectory. The plane motion model of interceptor projectile considering curvature and rotation of the earth is established. According to the requirements of subsistent trajectory restraint, the trajectory problem was established with maximum terminal velocity, minimum miss distance and minimum whole heat quantity. The results show that the hybrid genetic algorithm is better than the genetic algorithm. The hybrid genetic algorithm is used to optimize the trajectory of aircraft interceptor projectiles. There is no dependence on initial value of traditional optimization methods, and the optimal value can be searched globally. By using hybrid genetic algorithm and genetic algorithm, the normal overload of interceptor missile channel is much more stable, and it is easy to maneuver interceptor missile control.

articleTitle: Development of PCB Board Coding Equipment Based on New Digital Signing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In view of the typical defects in the use of several commonly used identification technologies for quality control in circuit board workshops, a new type of digital identification technology is proposed. Based on this technology, a new type of automatic identification coding equipment that can be adapted to commonly used PCB circuit boards is developed. After insulation, high and low temperature, vibration and shock, salt spray and other environmental adaptability tests, using this device to assign codes is convenient and reliable.
