The PCB circuit board identification code is firm, safe and easy to read, which helps to improve the data in the workshop production process Collection, thereby improving product quality control.

articleTitle: Research on Speaker Identification Models Based on CNN and Additive Angular Margin Loss
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In view of the traditional speaker identification methods which usually have poor generalization ability and high computational complexity, three text-independent closed-set speaker identification models named Res-SD, Res-SArc and Rep-SArc respectively are designed based on the Red-Song dataset constructed by us. Res-SD is trained by using the traditional cross-entropy loss, while Res-SArc and Rep-SArc are trained by using additive angular margin loss that optimizes the feature embedding to realize higher intra-class similarity and higher inter-class diversity. In terms of the number of model parameters, Rep-SArc accounts for only 1/3 of Res-SArc. Test experiments for evaluating three models are conducted on the Red-Song dataset's test set. In terms of identification accuracy, Rep-SArc and Res-SArc are more competitive among three models, and their identification accuracies reach 97.90% and 97.19%, respectively. The experimental results validate that these three models are effective for the text-independent closed-set speaker identification tasks.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Corporate Sustainable Value Assessment Based on Discounted Cash Flow Method and MCDM Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: After the concept of sustainable development was introduced, corporate goals gradually shifted from maximizing shareholder value to the management of stakeholders and their relationships. Reasonable and accurate corporate value assessment can provide useful information to stakeholders and help companies develop better. Therefore, this paper proposes a new approach to measure the sustainable value of a company and tests and analyzes the sustainable value model of a company through a case study. The method not only introduces the concept of value volume, which makes the assessment result of company value more accurate; but also makes the sustainable value of the company cross-sectionally comparable.

articleTitle: Anti-Occlusion and Anti-deformation Hand Tracking Based on Kernel Correlation Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of digital technology and multimedia technology, somatosensory games, smart TV, sign language teaching and so on often need hand tracking. Tracking the hand with the Kernel Correlation Filtering(KCF) target tracking algorithm, when the target is blocked or deformed, the success rate will decrease. To solve these problems, an anti-occlusion and anti-deformation hand tracking algorithm based on KCF is proposed. Firstly, the extracted Histograms of Oriented Gradients(HOG) and Color Name(CN) features are directly fused and adaptively fused. In the training stage, the multi-template kernel correlation filter is used for training, and the responses of the two filters are fused adaptively in the detection stage. Secondly, the size of the response matrix and the positional relationship of specific values in the response matrix are used to judge the occlusion and deformation. Finally, if it is determined that occlusion or deformation occurs, the target is re-detected by skin color detection and some parameter adjustment. The analysis of experimental results on LaSOT data set and randomly intercepted data set shows that the performance of this algorithm is better than many existing algorithms, and the tracking accuracy and overlapping success rate are 8.7% and 2.6% higher than those of the corresponding algorithm ranked second.

articleTitle: Chinese Knowledge Graph Completion based on Improved BERT Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The existing knowledge graph completion methods ignore semantic information, and there are relatively little researches on Chinese corpus. To solve the above problems, this paper first proposes an improved BERT model based on mean-pooling strategy to effectively solve the problem of insufficient sequence representation ability of BERT model; Then, the entity description information is introduced as the knowledge supplement of the model input, which solves the problem of insufficient background knowledge of the previous model; Finally, the knowledge completion problem is transformed into a classification problem. The experimental results show that this method improves the mean rank (MR) index by 5.83 compared with the traditional method, and the top 10 hit rate (Hit@10) The index is improved by 1.67%, which verifies the effectiveness of the model in Chinese corpus.

articleTitle: Colloidal PbS QDs heterostructure photodetector based on high-quality graphene
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: We propose a novel infrared photodetector composed of lead sulfide quantum dots and graphene which delivers a high responsivity of 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> A/W at 980nm. We demonstrate the fast response to infrared light in different optical power. Simultaneously we have obtained the carrier mobility of 3500 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> in graphene and Raman spectrum to verify its high quality.

articleTitle: Distributed communication of inter-satellite link based on time reversal method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the development of military aerospace, the space field has become an important space for the control of information rights. In order to improve the reliability and flexibility of space-based information equipment, the realization of the functions of large satellites through the cooperation of multiple small satellites has become a hot research direction. The basis of satellite cooperation is the ability of inter-satellite communication. The traditional centered inter-satellite network has low survivability. If a satellite, especially the satellite responsible for network management, fails, it will cause greater damage to the entire satellite network function. This paper proposes a distributed communication method for inter-satellite links based on a time reversal algorithm. When a small number of satellites fail, other satellites can still retain most of the communication functions.

articleTitle: Outlook and Direction of AI Tour Guide Services - from the Lifelong Machine Learning View
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has entered tourism and become a new service in a tour guide. AI technology can help tourism by providing customized services and attracting visitors to fight with the crisis of the COVID-19 epidemic. This paper introduces how AI tour guide services contribute to tourism and its main issues. The future development of AI tour guides also was discussed at the end and the authors believe lifelong machine learning is the key to developing AI tour guides.

articleTitle: Scorpio: an Automated Penetration Testing Tool and Its Integration with a Cyber Range
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Executing cyber attacks attribution experiments for training defenders is an important usage of cyber ranges. During the experiment, attack simulation process needs manual operation of highly skilled personnel, but the procedure is labor intensive and human could cause errors, an attack simulation tool for cyber ranges is needed. We propose Scorpio, an automated penetration testing tool to simulate an attacker's behavior with seamless scanning and automated exploit process. And for integrate with cyber ranges, we find a method for virtual machines in a cyber range to communicate with the manage server without breaking the network isolation, with this method, visualization mechanism is also supported. We conducted an experiment with Scorpio in a range for showing the whole automated attack simulation and visualization process. Result shows that, with Scorpio equipped, the manual operation of professional penetration testers for attack simulation could be replaced, that is cost-efficient and time-saving.

articleTitle: Research on the current situation of new digital infrastructure construction in Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Building digital Shandong is a vivid practice of implementing the strategy of Digital China. To promote the construction of digital Shandong, we must further promote the construction of new digital infrastructure. Only with the rapid development of new digital infrastructure can we promote the deep integration of Internet, big data, artificial intelligence and real economy, comprehensively enhance the core competitiveness. Summarize the important measures taken by Shandong Province to promote the construction of new digital infrastructure, and analyze the current status of the construction of new digital infrastructure, expected to provide ideas for Shandong Province to build a five-in-one digital infrastructure of “ubiquitous connection, efficient collaboration, global perception, intelligent integration, security and credibility”.

articleTitle: Mobile intelligent terminal privacy continuous protection system based on usage habits
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Explicit authentication of mobile intelligent terminals is easy to be stolen or learned and cannot be continuously authenticated. We propose a continuous privacy protection system based on user habits. By using the touch screen and sensor data in smart mobile terminals, the legitimate users and illegal users of smart mobile terminals are distinguished. By installing applications on mobile intelligent terminals, the system obtains relevant data and uploads them to the cloud server. LSTM algorithm is used to determine behavior types, and CNN-LSTM algorithm is used to extract features and build user feature models. The model is then downloaded to local and updated regularly. If illegal users are detected during the use of smart mobile terminals, measures will be taken to protect the privacy of users. The system effectively realizes an implicit and continuous authentication mode, and effectively protects the privacy of users. Compared with explicit authentication, it has obvious advantages in security, accuracy, stability and total cost control.

articleTitle: Enhanced wafer level variability improvement by customized wafer dose patterning by shot in DRAM
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As DRAM technology advances combined with more complex process steps than logic, cumulative effect of process variations leads to complicated shot-to-shot or die-to-die distribution in device electrical parameters. In this paper, ion implantation SuperScan by customized wafer dose patterning by shot is introduced to improve the shot-to-shot variability within zone in DRAM process. The wafer level throughput time of ion implantation gets no increase for mass production. The IDS uniformity improvement within zone is up to ∼40%, which then contributes to overall wafer level uniformity improvement (up to ∼30%). Wafer level yield improvement (up to ∼9%) has been verified, which is a major achievement for mass production.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation for Smart Electricity Meters Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The performance evaluation for Smart Electricity Meters (SEMs) is essential for the device design and electric energy metering, especially in the typical natural environment such as dry heat. Nevertheless, the real performance evaluation is often affected by insufficient and unsuitable feature information. To address this problem, this research provides a performance evaluation model for SEMs by using the machine learning method. First, the Spearman Correlation Coefficient (SCC) is used to assign the different feature weights. These features include run time and corresponding environmental features including temperature and humidity. Next, a Compound Kernel Support Vector Regression (CKSVR) is proposed to fuse these weighted feature information and then predict the metering error change for SEMs. Examples from the Xinjiang high dry heat region demonstrate that the proposed SEMs evaluation model has higher metering error prediction performance and can provide the specific influence degree of different feature information, which can be used for the health management and standard validation of SEMs under typical natural environment.

articleTitle: k-space based reconstruction method for wave encoded bSSFP sequence
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Purpose: To propose a parallel MRI model of wave encoded 2D bSSFP sequence k-space reconstruction based on SPIRiT. Theory and Methods: It is an advantage that MRI images are more stable in k-space reconstruction than in image domain reconstruction. Therefore, SPIRiT method is used to improve the stability of the reconstructed image. In addition, simulation experiments are carried out to further observe the reconstruction effect of wave encoded bSSFP sequence based on SPIRiT. In vivo experiments, compare the wave 2D bSSFP sequence reconstructed based on SPIRiT with the general bSSFP sequence. Results: Simulation and in vivo experiments show that in the reconstruction process of wave encoded bSSFP sequence, compared with the general bSSFP sequence, the g-factor decreased. Based on SPIRiT reconstruction method can reconstruct a stable and good image under 4-fold acceleration by using simpler empirical selection parameters. Conclusion: For the wave encoded bSSFP sequence, the reconstruction model based on SPIRiT avoids the problem of decreasing the reconstruction robustness due to inaccurate sensitivity estimation. The imaging uniformity is good and has good research value.

articleTitle: Design of Ultrasonic Range Finder Based on STM32 Single Chip Computer
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the principle of ultrasonic ranging, using STM32 single-chip microcomputer as the control core, using the transit time detection method, using the HC-SR04 ranging module, an ultrasonic wave with voice broadcast, over-range alarm, liquid crystal display and wireless communication functions is realized range-finder. Circuit design includes ranging, display, sensor, voice alarm and communication design; subprogram design includes ranging, display, voice alarm, and wireless communication. Through debugging and measurement, it is shown that the measurement accuracy of the range-finder is up to 1cm, the detection range is up to 340cm, and the measurement results can be voiced and wirelessly transmitted.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Selection Method Based On Electronic Component Quality Data System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of electronic component quality data management and application, and the lack of data system and application methods required for data management in selection scenarios, this paper proposes an intelligent selection method based on electronic component quality data system, uses Bi-LSTM-ATT model for entity identification, and identifies data association based on entity relationship. By calculating the Tanimoto coefficient, the intelligent matching and push of similar products and substitute products are realized, and the intellectualization of component selection is fully supported. Finally, taking the scenario of fast switching diode selection as an example, the feasibility of the method proposed in this paper is verified, which provides a model for the intelligent application of quality data resources.

articleTitle: A Smart Metasurface Based on Q-Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: We present a 2-bit coding smart metasurface with reinforcement learning algorithm is to realize adaptive control of moving states. The smart metasurface is composed of 20*20 elements, and each element contains two Positive-Intrinsic-Negative diodes. By configuring sensors and micro-control units, the smart metasurface can obtain the ability of adaptive adjustment. A reinforcement learning algorithm is designed to allow the metasurface to perceive the surrounding source and acquire self-learning capabilities. Experiments show that after sufficient real-time training, the metasurface can complete the complicated tasks with excellent accuracy and high efficiency, suggesting multiple potential applications in beam scanning and encrypted communication.

articleTitle: The design of fault diagnosis system of equipment operating status based on ITD and LCD
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The paper shows that it design a fault diagnosis system which is based on VB.NET development environment, and the system is use for the large rotating machinery equipment. The system includes an adaptive time-frequency analysis method. For the method, an improved algorithm combining ITD, LCD and Hilbert envelope spectrum is proposed and introduced into the system. It's of great significance for extracting the fault characteristic frequency of complex non-stationary signals in the industrial field. In addition, the system can build the relationship with simulation analysis of MATLAB to verify the accuracy and reliability of algorithm. The application of this method to the simulated signal and field engineering signals. The research results show that the system can be used to identify rolling bearing faults, realize equipment fault detection, determine fault types, and ensure safe and reliable operation of equipment.

articleTitle: PCRLB for Multiple Target Tracking Based on Symmetric Measurement Equation with Pd< 1
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Calculation of Cramer-Rao Lower Bound conditioned by missed detection is a basic problem in multiple target tracking. The Multiple Target Tracking problem is transformed into a nonlinear state estimation one using Symmetric Measurement Equation firstly. Then the calculation of PCRLB for single target based on Information Reduction Factor is introduced and modified. The PCRLB with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Pd} < 1$</tex> in MTT is then proposed by combing SME and two PCRLB above. At last, an application of tracking multiple targets in two dimensions in presented to verify the new PCRLB.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Secure Mutual Authentication Protocol for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: To solve the problem of high overhead and low security of some traditional IoT authentication protocols, a lightweight authentication protocol based on a physical unclonable function is proposed. The protocol limits the authentication information that an attacker may obtain through a two-stage authentication process controlled by two physical unclonable function (PUF) instances and can effectively resist a variety of attacks including PUF modeling attacks while maintaining a small hardware overhead. The proposed protocol is simulated by FPGA and analyzed by theoretical and experimental results. The protocol has a simple structure, low hardware, and communication overheads compared to the same type of design. It can resist a variety of attacks and is suitable for authenticating between IoT devices.

articleTitle: Design of vehicle intelligent distributor based on solid-state power distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the automotive technology development of integration trend, this paper proposed a design method in which the “Solid-state isolation driver + MOS tube” mode can replace the traditional solid-state relay (SSR) mode. In this method, the MOS tube which is the main calorific value device of SSR is designed outside the SSR. This paper also described the circuit design in detail through the example of a vehicle intelligent distributor. The design method is proved to be reasonable, feasible, and engineering-realizable by successfully passing the simulation and physical verification.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Distribution Grid Considering Flexible Grid Connection of Distributed Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the flexible access of distributed photovoltaics to the distribution network affects its reliability, this paper establishes a model of the distributed photovoltaic output probability based on the typical output characteristics of distributed photovoltaics firstly. Subsequently, the power grid risk assessment indicators are determined to facilitate the quantification of distribution network risks, including voltage over-limit, power over-limit, and load loss risk indicators. Finally, a distribution network model containing distributed photovoltaic grid-connected is established on the MATLAB simulation platform, and the risk assessment of the distribution network containing distributed photovoltaic grid-connected is carried out.

articleTitle: Remote sensing images object detection based on channel aware attention networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Due to remote sensing images have the characteristics of the large variations in object scale, complex background, and noise, object detection on remote sensing images has always been difficult problem in the field of computer vision. In order to make full use of the correlation of each channel of the feature map, our paper proposes a channel aware network based on FPN network and attention mechanism. The network adaptively assigns weights to the characteristics of each channel to achieve the purpose of suppressing background information and enhancing object information. In addition, our paper also combines the channel aware attention networks with FCOS network, and uses the GIOU Loss function and Focal loss function for training. Comparative experiments were conducted on the DOTA data set. The experimental results show that the FCOS algorithm based on the channel aware attention network has higher detection accuracy and detection speed, which is better than the existing object detection methods.

articleTitle: The Decoding Method of LDPC based on Dynamic Maximum Iteration in Physical Downlink Shared Channel data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to decode Physical Downlink Shared Channel data in 5G new radio, a method is proposed for Low Density Parity Check decoder in terminal equipment. It can hold the downlink throughput and lower down the power. According to the characteristics of low density parity check codes in 3GPP standard, this method simplifies the layering scalefactor min-sum method. The dynamic maximum iteration method is used to lower down the parallel processing and decrease the time delay. The simulation result shows that it is fast in decoding Physical Downlink Shared Channel data of lower SNR.

articleTitle: The impact of R&D investment on patent quality and its moderation and mediation effects–Empirical analysis based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to clarify the mechanism of regional GDP in the impact of R&D investment on patent quality, this study constructs a moderation and mediation model to examine the mediation and moderation effects of regional GDP in the relationship between the two. In this study, 78 new energy automobile companies were selected as the research objects, the relevant financial and patent data from 2010 to 2018 were collected and analyzed. The results show that: (1) R&D investment has a significant positive impact on patent quality; (2) Regional GDP as a moderating variable has a significant impact on the process of R&D investment affecting patent quality; (3) The impact of regional GDP as a mediating variable on patent quality is not significant. The research results have a positive effect on enterprises to explore how to improve innovation capability.

articleTitle: Game Model in Multi-target Jamming Task Allocation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In electronic warfare, the electronic jamming is used to decrease the detect ability of airborne radar and the optimal allocation of jamming resources directly affects jamming effectiveness. In this paper, a task allocation strategy for multi-target jamming in dynamic air-raid combat is proposed by using the potential game theory. First, the multi-target jamming task allocation problem is formulated in dynamic scenarios. To cope with this issue, a jamming resource allocation game is proposed to find the satisfied strategy profile with limited jamming resource. In addition, we prove that the proposed game is an exact potential game and the Nash Equilibrium (NE) can be reached as the end stable solution. Finally, the best response learning algorithm is proposed for multi-target jamming task allocation. Some simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed learning algorithm can converge to the optimal strategy of proposed game model with lower computation complexity.

articleTitle: Speed and Quality of Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Optimization problems are crucial in artificial intelligence. Optimization algorithms are generally used to adjust the performance of artificial intelligence models to minimize the error of mapping inputs to outputs. Current evaluation methods on optimization algorithms generally consider the performance in terms of quality. However, not all optimization algorithms for all test cases are evaluated equal from quality, the computation speed should be also considered for optimization tasks. In this paper, we investigate the quality and speed of optimization algorithms in optimization problems, instead of the one-for-all evaluation of quality. We select the well-known optimization algorithms (Bayesian optimization and evolutionary algorithms) and evaluate them on the benchmark test functions in terms of quality and speed. The results show that BO is suitable to be applied in the optimization tasks that are needed to obtain desired quality in the limited function evaluations, and the EAs are suitable to search the optimal of the tasks that are allowed to find the optimal solution with enough function evaluations. This paper provides the recommendation to select suitable optimization algorithms for optimization problems with different numbers of function evaluations, which contributes to the efficiency that obtains the desired quality with faster speed for optimization problems.

articleTitle: Study on Segmentation Technology of Thyroid Nodules Based on Improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Ultrasound segmentation of thyroid nodules is one of the key technologies to discover and identify malignant thyroid tumors [1]. The research content of this paper mainly includes three parts: data set selection, image preprocessing, and segmentation of thyroid nodules. The image preprocessing includes ROI selection, adaptive histogram equalization that limits the contrast, and data set expansion. In the segmentation of thyroid nodules, this article chooses to improve the U-Net model. The BN and GN modules are added to the U-Net model, and the activation function is changed to Leaky ReLU. In the end, the model's Miou reached 80.14%, the PA reached 94.33%, the Precision rate reached 90.37%, and the Recall rate reached 88.91 %. In addition, this article also uses PyQt5 to systematically visualize the preprocessing and nodule segmentation. The system can complete the segmentation of thyroid nodules in 4–5 seconds.

articleTitle: Study on Transmission Line Image Defect Recognition Algorithm based on Faster-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The artificial observation method for transmission line body defects has the problems of high working intensity and low efficiency. In this paper, a Faster-RCNN based on transmission line defect detection algorithm is proposed. By building a fault detection network framework, ZFNet and VGG16 models are analyzed in depth. Through a large number of iterative training experiments, the results show that the average defect recognition rate of VGG16 network is higher than that of ZFNet with the same number of iterations. At the same time, the higher the number of iterations, the higher the average defect recognition rate. The average defect recognition rate of VGG16 network is as high as 91.1 % after 400 000 iterations, which can effectively improve the efficiency of transmission line defect recognition and provide technical means for automatic identification of transmission line defects. Keywords: Faster-RCNN; defect recognition; transmission line; network training

articleTitle: TPSO Based Multi-Parameter ADC Background Calibration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-parameter high resolution ADC digital background calibration method based on traction particle swarm optimization (TPSO) is proposed. In this method, the traditional particle swarm optimization (PSO) is improved to make the algorithm more suitable for the application of hardware circuits, and the accurate calibration of high resolution ADC is realized. Different from traditional ADC calibration algorithms, which can only compensate for one error, this algorithm can simultaneously calibrate multiple errors, such as time jitter, comparator offset, capacitance mismatch, operational amplifier nonlinearity, etc. Firstly, this algorithm deeply analyzes the causes and ways of ADC errors with different architectures. Then, ADC models with different architectures and resolutions are built and error injection is performed on them. Finally, The PSO algorithm is used to calibrate Flash ADC. For the hardware characteristics of Pipeline ADC, the TPSO algorithm is proposed to achieve high performance calibration. This paper modeled 3-bit Flash ADC, 5-bit Flash ADC, and 14-bit pipeline ADC and used the algorithm proposed in this paper to calibrate them respectively. Specifically, the SNDR is improved from 18.65 dB to 26.90 dB in the 5-bit flash ADC case. Similarly, in the 14-bit pipeline ADC case, the SNDR is improved from 52.60 dB to 81.7 dB and the SFDR is improved from 69.80 dB to 97.83 dB. Moreover, these calibrations are finished with less than 100,000 sampling points. Therefore, the experimental results show that the proposed method not only has good robustness and accurate calibration performance but also has a fast convergence rate.

Author Keywords: signal to noise and distortion ratio (SNDR)

articleTitle: Journal Profile Based on Feature Words Extracting and Feature Co-occurrence Analyzing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: To analyze the characteristics of journals, and ultimately help readers make better use of journals to perform scientific or technological research as well as help journals improve their publication quality, a method of journal profiling by using text mining algorithms such as feature words extraction and word co-occurrence is put forward. As an empirical experiment, a total of 5010 articles are gathered from two Chinese journals: Computer Engineering and Design and Computer Engineering & Science. Firstly, the Word2vec model proposed by Google is used to build vector representation models for text features. After that, feature words are extracted by using the Chi-square test, and feature co-occurrence matrices are obtained by counting the number of co-occurrences within the context. Finally, according to the feature words and co-occurrence words of different journals, their journal profiles are generated and visualized by using bar charts and semantic network graphs. The results of this research show that using text mining can better understand the common academic characteristics of papers published in journals in the same field and the personalized publishing preferences of different journals. This comparison of journal profiles can help researchers better choose appropriate reference journals, as well as help journals discover their strengths and weaknesses and improve the quality of their publications.

articleTitle: 2-D Molecular Descriptor Screening and Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship Modeling for Estrogen Receptors Alpha Bioactivity
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of data mining in the field of computational biology and bioinformatics in recent years, it is possible to develop better quantitative prediction models based on these methods. Quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) of compounds can be modeled using molecular descriptors and bioactivity data of compounds, so as to predict new compound molecules with better bioac-tivity, or guide the structural optimization of existing active compounds. In the molecular descriptors of compounds, 2-D descriptors can be easily obtained through COTS toolbox, so as to avoid some complex descriptor calculation methods. However, 2-D descriptors also have the problems of over fitting and poor model interpretation. In this paper, the recursive feature elimination based on random forest (RFE-RF) is used to sort 2-D molecular descriptors. In each round of recursion, RF is used to eliminate the features, and the molecular descriptors that have the greatest impact on bioactivity are selected round by round. RFE-RF significantly reduces the types of descriptors, not only improves the calculation speed of the prediction model, but also effectively avoids the common over fitting problem in computational biology. The selected molecular descriptors are used to model, train and verify RF model. The regression model can predict the bioactivity of compounds against Estrogen receptors alpha, and Estrogen receptors alpha is an important target for breast cancer treatment. In this paper, the predicted data and experimental data are compared and analyzed, and the correctness and applicability of the modeling are evaluated from the aspects of variance, standard deviation, mean absolute error and root mean square error.

articleTitle: the Experimental Study of Low Voltage Line Contact Undesirable Based on the Needle-Plate Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The study make a needle-plate model to simulate contact undesirable of low voltage line, chang the position of the model in the circuit, collect the voltage waveform of null line while model in different position of circuit. The experiment study show that there are different discharge characteristics of null line voltage waveform when the model in different position of circuit, and it has a certain regularity.

articleTitle: Fast-QMIX: Accelerating Deep Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Virtual Weighted Q-values
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Cooperation between agents in a multi-agent system (MAS) is prevalent in real or virtual environments. In a fully cooperative environment, each agent learns its own policy by using the overall reward. QMIX adds an additional parametric network to replace the linear summation of values in Value-Decomposition Networks (VDNs), aiming to learn more complex relationships between agents. However, QMIX can not determine the best value for each agent during the process, resulting in slower convergence, instability of training, and poor performance. In this paper, we further dynamically assign virtual weighted Q-values based on QMIX with an additional network to further utilize the global information as an auxiliary guide and expand the ability to explore while also expand the robustness of the algorithm. Experiments show that our method not only outperforms original QMIX in different scenarios of the StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC) but also converges faster and more stable with the addition of calibration.

articleTitle: GLRT for Adaptive Array Signal Detection in the Presence of Spatial Steering Vector Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: We adopt a subspace model to take the spatial steering vector uncertainties into account for the problem of adaptive array signal detection. By assuming the spatial steering vector is located in a pre-designed subspace, a generalized likelihood ratio test (GLRT) is derived without employing secondary data. Closed-form expressions for the probabilities of detection and false alarm in the mismatched case are proposed, and the latter proves that the proposed GLRT exhibits constant false alarm rate property with respect to the noise covariance matrix. Monte Carlo simulation results demonstrate that the proposed GLRT is more robust against steering vector uncertainties compared to its counterpart.

articleTitle: Semantic Similarity Calculation based on Adaptive Semi-supervised Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Semantic similarity calculation is a key problem in natural language processing tasks. Supervised language models have been widely used in semantic similarity calculation. However, when a small part of the labeled data is used for training, the accuracy of the supervised model will be greatly reduced. An important issue is how to effectively use labeled and unlabeled data to build models. Thus, we propose an adaptive semi-supervised semantic similarity calculation method that combines the learning content of the supervised model Siamese LSTM with the topic information of the unsupervised LDA topic model through an attention layer. Inspired by active learning, we apply an adaptive mechanism to actively optimize model parameters. We apply this method to standard semantic datasets for ablation experiments. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method considerably outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: The factors affect the usage of mobile App of banking service
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Base on ECT-IS model and Perceived Service Quality, this model focus on the factors impacts personal consumer willing of continuous use of mobile App of banking. Research result found Perceived efforts impact consumers perceived performance directly and results with satisfaction and continuous use. Research also found that social influence impact consumer's perceived service quality, then results with its satisfaction and continuous use. Hence, this study suggest managers of banker shall pay attention to the efforts of use of App and social influence to make their App friendlier to use and build a mobile pop leader to influence consumers to a friendlier App.

articleTitle: Position control of XY precision planar motion table based on input shaping filter
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to solve the vibration problem of mining equipment, a Simulink simulation model of current loop, speed loop and position loop of permanent magnet synchronous motor was established to track the input position signal of the motor system.[1] At the same time, the input shaper is introduced into the motor three loop control model to study the vibration suppression effect of the input shaper.[2] The essence of the input shaper is to filter the input signal. Usually, the parameters of the input shaper need to be accurately identified and the detailed parameters of the system need to be identified. However, the problem that the identification accuracy of the system is not enough often makes the parameters of the shaper uncertain. In view of the problem that the system identification is not accurate, a method of adjusting and setting input shaper parameters is designed, which is not very dependent on the system. The results show that the optimal parameters of the shaper can be selected by the method. Compared with the parameters of the shaper selected according to the identification model, the vibration suppression effect is better.

articleTitle: Design of Test instrument for Executing Components in a Certain Aircraft Weapon Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In the process of test and diagnosis, the test equipment for execution component in a certain aircraft weapon control system needs complex operations and manual trouble shooting, so test diagnosis is inefficient. To improve test efficiency, a new test instrument for executing components in a certain aircraft weapon control system was designed. Firstly, according to the test requirement based on the relationship with input and output of the executing component. The system structure and working principle of the test instrument were designed. And then, we built the circuit of test system based on STC89C51 microcontroller which had the function of receiving and sending eight-channel switching signal. The software based on keil development environment for the STC89C51 microcontroller was designed with C-language which contained test and diagnostic modules. Finally, multiplexing test technique and fault dictionary method were used to set up the fault of execution component. The key control module of the tester was used to simulate all possible test situations, and the effectiveness of the tester was verified. The practical application showed that the test equipment could automatically locate faults to the component level and effectively improve the efficiency of testing and diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Generation Method of Innovative Enterprise Evaluation Text
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The evaluation text of innovative companies results from natural language processing. However, there are two shortcomings in the generation of evaluation texts: rough processing and failure to consider the evaluation index system. This paper proposes a model using BiLSTM+Attention+p value, using BiLSTM+Attention to obtain the relevant information of each indicator from the knowledge graph to make the sentence accurate and considering the p-value to combine the corpus and the knowledge graph make sentences more fluent. The experimental results show that compared with the basic model that does not use the knowledge graph to connect many indicators and the coarse-grained processing that does not consider the coverage of each indicator, our framework has improved scores on ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L.

articleTitle: Generating Emotional Coherence and Diverse Responses in a Multimodal Dialogue System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The perception of emotion and the diversity of generated response are two key factors considered by researchers in multimodal dialogue generation. However, in the field of multimodal dialogue generation, these two key factors have not been considered at the same time. In our model, we first extract the features of each modal from the multimodal context dialogue, and use the heterogeneous graph neural network to represent the large graph network composed of dialogue history, voice, video, and speaker's emotional state. Then, we use conditional variational autoencoders to generate coherent and diverse responses. A large number of experiments have shown that our model can not only automatically generate reaction emotions in two multimodal datasets, but also has coherence and controllability, which is significantly better than previous more advanced models.

articleTitle: Terminal response of non-uniform transmission line based on microwave network parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to study the terminal response characteristics of non-uniform line on a lossy ground exposed in radiation field, the formula of terminal response of abruptly non-uniform line above a lossy ground was derived based on transmission line model and microwave network transition matrix. The terminal response of the abruptly non-uniform line can be calculated accurately based on the derived formula. The experiment was designed to measure the terminal current response of a transmission line with a converter. The measured results are compared with the theoretical results, which are in good agreement. The method of microwave network transition matrix in this paper is especially suitable for the calculation of the response of the abruptly non-uniform lines.

articleTitle: Integrated Reliability and Performance Design Method of Hybrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Based on the reliability and performance integrated design theory of hybrid system, this paper analyzes the integrated optimization model of reliability and performance to realize their coordinated design and synchronous optimization. The implementation process of reliability and performance integrated design is proposed. The application of reliability and performance integrated design technology is verified by a hybrid system design example. The research here changes the traditional serial design mode in which performance is before reliability. The design efficiency of hybrid system is effectively improved in this way.

articleTitle: Recognizing Sentences Concerning Research Methods of Citation from the Full Text of JASIST
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Citing behavior is the basic academic behavior of researchers, which can reflect the situation that researchers refer to previous research results, show the inheritance and communication of Science, and also show respect for others' research results. Citation analysis has always been an important research method in bibliometrics and is often used in hot spot research and trend analysis of disciplines. In this paper, deep learning method is used to fine-tune a pre-training model to predict whether sentence-level data in academic full-text is a citation research method. The average effect of the model is 85.47%, which proves that the model can effectively identify citation methods in academic full-text.

articleTitle: Medical Consultation System based on Python Web crawler
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the development of the times and the continuous progress of society, the Internet has become the most representative of today's society. Medical data as an important part of network data, with the rapid development of the network also presents the trend of explosion. It is difficult for users to get useful data resources, which is a serious drawback of the Internet today. Although the traditional search engine can return a great deal of information to the user, the user must spend a great deal of time to obtain the information that is valid to itself. According to the background of big data era and the requirement of practical application, this paper gives some shallow opinions on the Web Crawler, introduces the importance of Web Crawler, and the system crawls medical data through Scrapy frame. The system mainly realizes the crawling and the data storage of the doctor information in the specific area and the designated department.

articleTitle: Design of Scintillation Counter Circuit Based on STM32 Counting
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The radiation of building materials is harmful to the human body. This paper designs a scintillation counter that can effectively detect the radiation of building materials. We design circuits for high-voltage power supplies, preamplifiers, analog power supplies, etc., and use STM32 and SSD1306-OLED to realize the counting function, and graphically display the collected radiation.

articleTitle: Chaotic Separation Constellation Scrambling Scheme to Enhance the Security of PDM CO-OFDM/OQAM Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a chaotic separation constellation scrambling scheme for PDM CO-OFDM/OQAM system. The statistical and simulation results show the proposed scheme can enhance the security of the system without transmission performance loss.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Assessment Based on Fuzzy Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In the process of aircraft vulnerability assessment, the model is always simplified because of inaccurate data, which leads to imprecise vulnerability assessment. In this paper, fuzzy mathematics and Bayesian network are used to evaluate aircraft vulnerability, which makes the vulnerability analysis more accurate. This paper introduces the basic knowledge of fuzzy theory and Bayesian network, as well as the aircraft vulnerability assessment process based on fuzzy Bayesian network, and establishes a vulnerability assessment model based on a certain type of aircraft. Finally, an example proves the rationality of this method.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Optimization Design for Airborne Fire-detecting System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiency of reliability design for traditional airborne fire-detecting system, the optimization design is carried out in this paper from four aspects: fire-detecting system architecture, fire detection circuit, data security strategy and built-in self-detection. An improved fire-detecting system architecture is proposed, which effectively reduces the transmission links of fire information and significantly improves the reliability of fire detection and fire alarm tasks. The full bridge conditioning mode is adopted to realize the detection of the full resistance range of the fire sensor, which increases the pollution detection capability of the fire sensor, and a high-reliability BIT detection circuit is designed to realize the online fault diagnosis of the system in the whole working cycle. At the same time, the security data strategy is designed for the information transmission process, which can effectively improve the confidence and reduce the false alarm rate. Both theoretical analysis and test results verify that the reliability of alarm task and the reduction of false alarm rate of the optimized fire-detecting system have been significantly optimized and improved. Furthermore the scheme can improve the accuracy and reliability of the fire-detecting system and enhance the safety of the aircraft.

articleTitle: Research on Metaverse: Concept, development and standard system
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Digitization, cyberization, and informationization of society have developed to a critical point at present. It leads to an explosion of the concept of Metaverse, which is not only a hot trend in the development of the Internet, but also brings new challenges. This article presents a point of view for the concept, features and core values of Metaverse, a short discussion of development status is made. In addition, the standard system architecture and framework of Metaverse were proposed according to the challenges and standardization requirements. To conclude, the proposals for the development of Metaverse are discussed.

articleTitle: An Self-supervised Learning & Self-attention Based Method for Defects Classification on PCB Surface Images
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Automatic detection of PCB defects become a difficult work in electronics industry, with the rapid development of Integrated Circuit. A good detection method can effectively improve production efficiency and reduce the costs of quality inspection. The traditional image processing methods have the backwards of complicated system structure, difficult image segmentation, and low detection accuracy, etc. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a method of extracting features by self-supervised learning with supervised learning to complete the classification task. This method uses a deep neural network model based on self-supervised learning technology, uses multi-head self-attention mechanism; automatically recognize single or multiple defect areas in PCB, to extract defects features of PCB, and uses full connection classifier to classify features. The open-source (DeepPCB) is selected as the dataset, including 6 defect categories and non-defect categories. In the training process, data enhancement technology is used to increase the training samples, train the model and make it converge, and realize low error recognition on the verification dataset. The experimental results show that the features extracted by the self-supervised learning method are richer than those extracted by the supervised learning. The composite model formed by combining the self-attention mechanism has high accuracy and good robustness, reaches the classification accuracy of 94.33%, and has high accuracy and good generalization ability.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneous Dual-Channel Routing Protocol Based on OLSR for FANETs
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Routing plays a crucial role in Flying Ad-Hoc networks (FANETs). The high-speed movement of nodes causes rapid changes in network topology. Traditional FANETs with single-channel nodes are prone to node isolation and network fragmentation due to limited communication distance, which in turn degrades the network performance. Heterogeneous dual-channel nodes can improve the reliability of FANETs by adding a low-frequency reliable control channel with a longer communication distance. However, there is no routing protocol available for this type of FANETs. To address the above problem, this paper proposes a routing protocol, called DC-OLSR (Dual-Channel OLSR) for heterogeneous dual-channel FANETs based on the well-known routing protocol OLSR. The protocol makes full use of the two channels for joint route discovery. By distinguishing the priorities of different data streams, data can be adaptively transmitted through the control channel and the data channel to ensure reliable transmission of critical data between critical nodes and improve the reliability and throughput of the whole network. Simulation results have shown that DC-OLSR significantly outperforms single-channel OLSR and AODV in terms of packet delivery rate and everage end-to-end transmission delay.

articleTitle: Improving Performance of Log Anomaly Detection With Semantic and Time Features Based on BiLSTM-Attention
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In recent years, with the increase in the scale and complexity of system software, how to effectively capture, analyze and locate the abnormal behavior generated during system operation has increasingly become a recognized problem in the software testing field. Traditional white-box-based anomaly detection methods need to provide system source code and cannot effectively detect abnormal behaviors that occur when the program is running. Black-box-based anomaly detection methods rely on test cases and have low code coverage. Anomaly detection based on the logs generated during system operation can alleviate the abovementioned problems. However, the existing system log-based abnormality detection method mainly extracts log template characteristics, and cannot effectively determine the logical and temporal abnormalities related to the log. Therefore, in order to detect anomalies in the log sequence more comprehensively, this paper proposes an anomaly detection method based on BiLSTM. This method combines the semantic and temporal characteristics of the log for modeling. In terms of semantics, the Bert natural language processing model is used to extract the contextual semantic information of the logs; in terms of time, the log time interval characteristics are extracted based on the three potential relationships of the logs. In addition, the proposed method also adds an attention mechanism to balance feature weights. Finally, we evaluate our method in experiments on two real datasets, HDFS and OpenStack. The experimental results show that our method has a great improvement in accuracy and recall.

articleTitle: A systematic review of fuzzy testing for information systems and applications
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Fuzzy testing is a widely used software vulnerability automation detection technology with the advantages of easy deployment and lightweight, which can test the target software quickly and efficiently and has good adaptability to modern large-scale software. This paper first introduces the technical principles and classification of fuzzy testing, and then summarizes the four development stages of fuzzy testing from its introduction to the present. At present, fuzzy testing has been transformed from a single technology composition to a system engineering with multi-technology integration. In this paper, we will systematically review all the technologies that can be combined with fuzzy testing. Fuzzy testing has different requirement when applied in different fields. This paper focuses on the use and development of fuzzy testing in protocol and firmware vulnerability detection from a practical perspective and compares the advantages and disadvantages of various types of fuzzy testing tools. Finally, we analyze the current problems existing in fuzzy testing and hope to provide some references for this field.

articleTitle: A Parameter-Adaptive Convolution Neural Network for Capturing the Context-Specific Information in Natural Language Understanding
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Natural Language Understanding (NLU) aims to make sense of language by enabling computers to comprehend text in semantic level, which is a fundamental but challenging task in natural language processing. Recently, BERT has achieved state-of-the-art performances in NLU utilizing pretraining and fine-tuning techniques to capture the task-specific information without any task-specific structure. However, the existing models still cannot capture context-specific information, leading to poor performance when dealing with the pervasive ambiguity of language caused by the polysemous words. In this paper, we propose a Parameter-Adaptive Convolution Neural Network (PACNN) to capture the context-specific information which can deal with the polysemous word better. Instead of the convolution layers in existing models, the parameters of convolutional filters in PACNN, generated by a deconvolution (e.g. convolution transpose) neural network, are adaptable according to the input sentences, which can filter the local information via the global information and capture the context-specific meaning of the polysemous words. We empirically demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed PACNN by performing a series of experiments on the General Language Understanding Evaluation (GLUE) benchmark, a collection of popular datasets on different tasks, and the PACNN significantly outperforms all the baselines. Besides, our model can be appended to BERT to further improve its performances. As BERT and the proposed PACNN capture information from various aspects, the proposed BERT+PACNN achieves the best performances compared with BERT and other baselines. Furthermore, we visualize the task-specific information and context-specific information captured by BERT and the PACNN, separately, using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to demonstrate the efficiencies of the two models further.

articleTitle: Using Occupant's Data for Electricity Load Prediction based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper uses machine learning techniques to model monthly electricity consumption data of Dubai, the United Arab Emirates, at a consumer level to predict month-ahead prediction. Mainly, statistical-based multivariate approaches are used in conjunction with weather data for modeling electricity consumption. However, in this study, data of occupant's profile is analyzed along with regular consumption data for modeling and capturing the trend of electricity consumption. First, the two data sets are joined to extract the consumer's profile-driven electricity consumption dataset. And then, a ranking-based feature selection using a correlation approach is used, and further, the outlier removal process is performed to obtain the filtered data. Among various machine learning approaches, the Random Forest approach is found to have a better model with the least RMSE and MAPE across a 5-fold cross-validation approach.

articleTitle: A Precision Clock Synchronization Method of Satellite Constellation Network Based on IEEE 1588 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid application of large-scale low-orbit constellations, precision clock synchronization of satellite constellation network has become an important issue. The traditional method, relying on GNSS timing service, has limited accuracy and is difficult to improve, and it is also easily unavailable in interference environment. It has become an inevitable trend to build precision clock synchronization through inter-satellite links in the constellation network, to meet the needs of distributed collaboration and signal-level coherent synthesis for distributed space systems. The IEEE 1588 precision clock synchronization protocol, used in terrestrial wired networks, is an excellent protocol, and it provides a useful reference for the design of satellite constellation network clock synchronization. Based on the transparent clock mechanism of the IEEE 1588 protocol, this paper builds a clock synchronization system for satellite constellation wireless network, and a precision time-frequency transfer mechanism for constellation network is proposed. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulation of synchronization performance are also carried out. The results show that the synchronization performance of the farthest clock of the constellation network is closely related to the inter-satellite distance and the relay hops, and it points out the optimal clock synchronization method under the condition of a certain transmission power.

articleTitle: A CVSS-based Vulnerability Assessment Method for Reducing Scoring Error
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Vulnerability assessment is one of the important topics in cyberspace security, which mainly includes threat assessment, risk level assessment, vulnerability rating score, etc. CVSS (Common Vulnerability Scoring System) is a commonly used vulnerability assessment method in academia and industry. However, CVSS has the following problems. First, CVSS is not very versatile in practical scoring. The value of the metrics will be different depending on the people with different domain knowledge and different working experience, which will lead to error in the final score. Second, the weight of CVSS metrics is more subjective. To reduce scoring error, in this paper, we propose a CVSS-based vulnerability assessment method to reduce the dimension of vulnerability metrics. This method contains a vulnerability evaluation model based on decision tree, which can reduce the error caused by manual scoring. The experiments show that the reduction of vulnerability metrics leads to a reduction in scoring error.

articleTitle: Coherent signals adaptive beamforming algorithm based on eigenvalue
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of beamformer performance degradation caused by coherent signals, We propose an adaptive beamforming algorithm for interference plus noise covariance matrix (INCM) reconstruction. The idea of the proposed algorithm is that the sum of eigenvalues (SE) is not affected by coherent signals, so that the power of the eigenvalues can be used to reconstruct INCM. First, we perform eigenvalue decomposition on the covariance matrix after the forward and backward spatial smoothing, which proves that spatial smoothing does not affect SE. On this basis, a new method of signal power estimation is proposed. The estimated signal power and direction vector are then used to reconstruct INCM. Finally, the weight vector is calculated from the estimated desired signal steering vector (DSDV) and the reconstructed INCM. The innovation of this algorithm lies in the combination of coherent signal processing and beamforming, which effectively improves the output interference plus noise ratio (SINR) performance of the beamformer. Simulation analysis verifies the superiority of the algorithm and the validity of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Urban road checkpoints traffic flow prediction model of hyper-parameter based on PSO optimization LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In view of the characteristics that traffic flow exhibits randomness, nonlinearity, and similarity due to the distinct environment, vehicles, roads, and people, this paper proposes an urban road checkpoints traffic flow prediction model of hyper-parameter based on PSO optimization LSTM. Which taking into account not only the influence of speed parameters, but also the traffic flow of upstream and downstream checkpoints on predicting traffic flow at target checkpoint, particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used to build a long short term memory model to optimize the learning rate, batch size, and the number of neurons of the model, the single long short term memory model (LSTM) is improved with the optimal hyper-parameter set. This paper takes the road checkpoints data in Xi'an as the research objective. According to the experimental results, the prediction accuracy of the model is far better than the traditional RF and SVM models, the error is significantly lower than the single LSTM model (working day: MSE 28%↓, MAPE8%↓; non-working days: MSE13%↓, MAPE3%↓).

articleTitle: Research on Military Internet of Things Technology Application in the Context of National Security
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Intelligent and information-based warfare is developing rapidly, which has a subversive effect on the combat pattern and rules of engagement. In order to firmly grasp the key to the victory of war, we must actively respond to many profound changes such as the mechanism of war victory, the generation mode of combat effectiveness, the mode of battlefield confrontation, and the battle command and decision making. The Military Internet of Things has been applied and gradually extended in all fields of the military, mainly realizing more transparent battlefield, more intelligent battlefield and simpler command process. This paper discusses that the concept of Internet of Things and the military Internet of Things technology are affecting the future information construction of our army, explains that the military Internet of Things technology is widely used to improve the early warning, intelligence sharing ability and support efficiency of the military, and can adapt to the needs of new fields of attack and defense, and puts forward suggestions on the development of military Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Method of System Reliability Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the current product development, such as poor coordination of system Reliability work, lack of effective model representation methods and supporting data, combined with the advantages of digital twin in model-driven and data-driven integration, and the requirements of Reliability integrated design, an system reliability digital twin model construction method is proposed, combines Reliability and functional characteristics elements. The concept of Reliability digital twin is defined, and the relationship between Reliability digital twin and MBSE-based Reliability is analyzed. Based on this, the construction process of product system Reliability digital twin model is given, the objects, basic models and data of relevant stages in the process are defined, and the construction idea and related basic models representation methods of system Reliability digital twin model are put forward. Finally, a case study of the power subsystem of a communication system is carried out, which lays an important foundation for the realization of forward design of product reliability based on digital twin.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Dialogue Model Combined With VAE For Task-oriented Dialogue System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Dialogue state tracking and dialogue response generation are two crucial modules in a task-oriented dialogue system. Recent works on task-oriented dialogue systems have mainly focused on studying the two modules separately without considering the end-to-end joint learning of them. For dialogue state tracking, many methods analyze the entire dialogue history, and this may result in larger memory usage and computational costs with the increase of dialogue histories. For dialogue response generation, oracle labels of the dialogue state are directly used to generate the response regardless of the vital impact the dialogue state tracking on it. In this paper, we propose a Probabilistic Graph-based end-to-end model combined with Variational Auto-Encoder(PGVAE), which jointly trains the dialogue state tracking and the dialogue response generation using the simplified dialogue context rather than the entire dialogue history. We address the issue of the loss of contextual information because of ignoring the history of dialogue by utilizing the dialogue state of the last turn as a summary of the history. Experimental results on real-world datasets of MultiWOZ 2.0 and MultiWOZ 2.1 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model for task-oriented dialogue systems.

articleTitle: Coverless Steganography Method based on the Source XML File Organization of OOXML Documents
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Existing search-based coverless text steganography algorithms according to the characteristics of the text, do not need to modify the carrier, and have good resistance to detection, but they rely on a large text data set and have a limited hiding capacity. For this reason, this paper proposes a coverless steganography method based on the source XML file organization of the OOXML documents from a new perspective. It analyzes the organization of OOXML documents, and uses the differences of organization to construct the mapping between documents and secret information, so as to realize the coverless information hiding. To achieve the efficiency of information hiding, a compound tree model is designed and introduced to construct the OOXML document category library. Compared with the existing coverless information hiding methods, the text set size that this method relies on is significantly reduced, and the flexibility of the mapping is higher under the similar hiding capacity.

articleTitle: Employing Gated Mechanism to Incorporate Symbolic Features into Chinese Event Coreference Resolution
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Event mentions are sparsely distributed in unstructured text where single event mention without coreferential relationship account for a large proportion. And most of the current studies focus on English events, whereas Chinese has the characteristics of pro-drop and zero entity coreference, making it more challenging to solve Chinese event coreference. In order to solve within-document Chinese event coreference, a new Gated Mechanism Neural Network (GMNN) based on the basic characteristics of events is proposed. First, the pre-trained language model BERT and a feedforward neural network are introduced to represent a small number of necessary basic features(event triggers and event arguments), and the vector representation of symbolic features (event subtypes and event basic attributes) is obtained by trainable embedding matrices; Then, the gated mechanism is used to filter the noise from the symbolic features, extract the useful information in the specific context, and form the event mention-pair representation together with the basic features; Last, a feedforward neural network is applied to calculate the coreference score of the mention-pair representation and output the coreference event cluster. The experiments on ACE2005 Chinese dataset show that the performance of GMNN is improved by 8.2% compared with the baseline.

articleTitle: Patient Similarity Measuring with Graph Embedded Learning and Triplet Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Electronic Health Records (EHR) are fast becoming the standard for patient medical record keeping. Patient similarity measuring enabled by EHRs has demonstrated the ability to assist doctors and other medical practitioners in clinical decision-making from prognosis, to diagnosis, to treatment options and treatment. Due to the complexity and heterogeneity of medical data, it remains a challenge to integrate critical latent information to estimate patient similarity. As a result, nuances like the ability of a medical entity to have multiple meanings in different contexts and its effect on whether patients are similar or not, a key player in mitigating misdiagnosis, remain a relevant problem. We seek to take full advantage of the usually heterogeneous data of EHRs, to more carefully measure patient similarity by modeling the medical entities they contain as well as their relationships both with the patient and with other medical entities in the patient EHR scenarios through the use of heterogeneous graph embed-dings and triplet networks. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm through experiments on breast cancer diagnosis and patient medical record data from a tertiary hospital.

articleTitle: Security Modules for Securing Industrial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This article focuses on the incident detection techniques of communication in the Modbus/TCP protocol. Modbus/TCP does not implement authentication or communication encryption. Therefore, a Modbus Security Module was created allowing sniffing a specific network traffic and parsing particular information from the packets. This information is stored in a database using PostgreSQL on each master and slave station. Such a technique brings a new way to perform incident detection and to evaluate the transmitted packet's authenticity and integrity. Data taken from the database are used for an incident detection via a trained neural network.
